chapters.title: Chapter 51 Softer Than Imagined
paragraphs: Liu Qingxuan recognized both items instantly, and her heartbeat quickened slightly. "Zhang Xian, these are..."
Zhang Xian's tone was sincere. "Supervisor Liu, I actually want to ask for your help regarding these two things!"
Liu Qingxuan was slightly taken aback. "Help?"

"This Marrow Cleansing remnant fruit—we tried to cultivate and repair it before, but failed!" Zhang Xian sighed lightly. "I wanted to ask whether Green Wood Peak's spiritual plant techniques could possibly revive it?!"

He pointed to the Heart-Mending Lotus seed next. "This Heart-Mending Lotus seed was obtained accidentally by an elder. Unfortunately, the lotus pod leaves have already withered. I fear the remaining few seeds' medicinal efficacy will be hard to preserve for long. I wonder if Supervisor Liu has any methods to maintain their efficacy?!"
Liu Qingxuan knew "we" referred to Zhang Xian's small world faction. Her eyes flickered, and her original intention to refuse dissipated somewhat.
So he's not simply giving gifts; he truly needs my help?!
Being needed made her somewhat happy.

She took the two spiritual items and examined them carefully, frowning slightly. "The Marrow Cleansing remnant fruit is indeed severely damaged. Since it is of Earth-grade rarity and its medicinal efficacy surpasses the Immortal Ascension Grass, the difficulty of repairing it is very high—success is slim!"

"As for this Heart-Mending Lotus seed, its quality is already infinitely approaching Earth-grade. If we can use ice and wood element techniques simultaneously to nurture it, perhaps we can delay its withering!!"

Zhang Xian immediately showed an expression of enlightenment, clasping his hands and saying, "So that is how it is!! Many thanks to Supervisor Liu for the guidance. I'll give these two things to you to help nurture and keep safe!!"
Liu Qingxuan: "...?"
Wait, how did it become me accepting them again?!
"This won't do!" she quickly said.

"The Marrow Cleansing remnant fruit is useless to me. If Supervisor can help repair it and return it later, I will definitely pay a satisfactory reward!! As for the Heart-Mending Lotus seed, I must trouble Supervisor to help find a nurturing method. If you succeed, this seed will be given to you as a reward!!"
Liu Qingxuan still wanted to decline, but Zhang Xian's face was solemn. "Supervisor Liu, this matter concerns an elder's cultivation bottleneck. Please, you must help!!"
She opened her mouth but finally sighed lightly and stored the items in her sleeve. "I'll try my best!!"
Watching Zhang Xian's completely calm expression, Liu Qingxuan felt strange inside, yet somewhat happy too.
[Ding! Gift Heart-Mending Lotus seed successful! Return: Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus seeds x10!]
[Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus seeds: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity. Can serve as the main ingredient for treating Spirit Root soul damage!]
[Ding! Gift Marrow Cleansing remnant fruit successful! Return: Marrow Cleansing Fruits x10!]
[Marrow Cleansing Fruits: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity. Direct consumption can improve Spirit Root quality. Effect decreases with repeated consumption!]

"Succeeded!!" Zhang Xian, seeing the system prompts that both returns had upgraded grades, momentarily forgot himself. He grabbed Liu Qingxuan's slender, jade-like hand, laughing happily. "Haha, Qingxuan, you are truly my lucky star!!
Liu Qingxuan's entire person froze stiff!!
"Zh-Zhang-Xian..." Her voice was so light it was barely audible, her ear tips visibly reddening rapidly.
The next moment, she quickly withdrew her hand behind her back as if electrocuted, her fingers unconsciously rubbing the spot he had just touched.

Zhang Xian then realized he had somewhat lost his composure. Liu Qingxuan was unlike Lin Yinyin, who was so unrestrained. Seeing that even her neck had turned pink, he hurriedly said, "Apologies, Supervisor Liu. I was too excited just now and acted somewhat impolitely!!"
"I-I need to prepare lessons!!" Liu Qingxuan's heart pounded wildly as she fled in a panic.
Not far away, several Green Wood Peak disciples hiding behind spiritual plants beat their chests and stomped their feet!!
"It's over, it's over! Supervisor has been taken advantage of by the old thief again!!"
"What help?! Clearly an excuse!! This guy's methods are too brilliant!!"
"Only giving things, not actively pursuing, letting Supervisor Liu lower her defenses herself—terrifying!!"
More people were heartbroken. "Did you notice?! Supervisor got touched by the old thief Zhang Xian, and not only was she not angry, she shyly ran away! When has she ever acted like this before?!"
Everyone fell silent, then became even more grief-stricken!!
Someone suddenly remembered something, looking around left and right. "Eh?! Where is Eldest Senior Brother?! How come we haven't seen him recently?!"

A nearby disciple said gloomily, "Oh, Lu Senior Brother got a monthly card at Zhiyin Sister's place on Heavenly Puppet Peak. He's been indulging every day recently, said he wants to be completely healed before returning!!"
Another asked, "What about Lu Renbing Junior Brother?! He hates Zhang Xian the most, right?!"
Another sighed. "Lu Junior Brother is daily churning out ten-chapter novels, repeatedly desecrating Zhang Xian's corpse. He's probably still writing right now!!"
All disciples collectively speechless: "..."
"Green Wood Peak is in danger! Supervisor Liu is going to fall!!"
Zhang Xian, humming a tune, returned to his grass hut. He sat cross-legged and entered a meditative state, the surrounding spiritual energy rising and falling like tides.

The Marrow Cleansing Fruit entered his abdomen, its medicinal efficacy transforming into scalding spiritual currents that scoured his meridians and bones. From deep within came subtle cracking sounds, as if some shackles were breaking inch by inch.
Once the anomaly subsided, Zhang Xian opened his eyes and took another!!
After consuming three Marrow Cleansing Fruits, he took out the Spirit-Testing Pearl, full of anticipation.
Purple!! Around position 70!!
He muttered to himself, "If I continue like this, maybe I can also turn waste into treasure and achieve a Supreme Spirit Root!!"

As for the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seeds, he had no use for them temporarily. That girl Yun Zhen'er might be able to consume them. Next time I see the Cloud Pavilion Mistress, I'll give them to her in person!!
Zhang Xian closed his eyes and meditated. Nearing evening, he sensed something and received a transmission from the Green Wood Peak Peak Master:

"Qingxuan has gone out shopping. Recently, I, this old man, will take over Green Wood Peak's morning and evening classes. I heard you gifted her two more heavenly treasures. She is naturally introverted and shy; I thank you on her behalf!"
"No need to thank me!"
Zhang Xian thought for a moment and replied with another sentence: "Supervisor Liu has helped me much; this student is very grateful!"
"Coming to attend class this evening? When will you come drink tea?" Liu Huaigu sent another message.
"Next time, definitely!"
Zhang Xian thoughtfully rubbed his fingertips. The unique silky smooth touch of a woman's skin still lingered there, carrying a faint scent of medicinal herbs.
"Softer than imagined!" Zhang Xian's lips curled into a meaningful smile.
Better go stroll other peaks instead! He picked up his transmission talisman and sent a message to Zhenhai: "Eldest Senior Brother, I want to go to other peaks to learn. Any recommendations?!"
Less than a minute later, Zhenhai transmitted a message: "Qinghui Peak, Illusion Sunset Peak—learn music and painting. Clouds of fairies are there!"
Zhang Xian: "..."
"Senior Brother has misunderstood. I am not that kind of person!" he explained.
"?!" Zhenhai sent a question mark back.

"Inglorious Peak is also not bad. They use dance instead of walking; movement techniques come first. The fairies there have lotus flowers blooming under their feet, their appearances unparalleled!" he recommended again.
Reading this, Zhang Xian wanted to flip a table. You're not listening to my explanation, are you?!
Then he calmed down and replied: "I want to learn technical skills like alchemy, talismans, puppets, and similar heavenly craft techniques!"
After a while, Zhenhai sent a message:
"Already arranged properly. Tonight, Dan Ding Peak!"

chapters.title: Chapter 52 Let’s Just Go Watch Dancing Instead
paragraphs: Evening, at the Alchemy Hall of Pill Cauldron Peak.
The vast Alchemy Hall was as noisy as a vegetable market, with several cultivators gathered around each alchemy furnace.
"Those bastards from the Lingxu Sect! They actually refined an Earth-grade pill!"
"They must have gotten incredibly lucky!"
"I refuse to accept this! Our Pill Cauldron Peak is the true orthodox school of alchemy in the Southern Region!"
On the other side, several cultivators with faces blackened by soot were still arguing.
"Junior Brother, I think this furnace needs my innate pill fire to finish with a strong flame; then this pill can be completed."
"No, no, it should be simmered slowly for another ten days."
When those disciples saw Zhang Xian and his companion, they acted as if they didn't see them, still busy with their own affairs.

On a raised platform sat an old man with red hair and beard, reclining on a rocking chair. A small furnace stood beside him, crackling as it burned. He had his eyes closed, humming a little tune, looking exactly like a farmer warming himself by a charcoal fire.
Zhenhai led Zhang Xian forward and cupped his hands in salute. "Disciple Zhenhai, along with Junior Brother Zhang Xian, pays respects to the Head Teacher."
Zhang Xian imitated him. "Pays respects to the Head Teacher."
The old man glanced at Zhang Xian. "A Wood Spirit Root learning alchemy? That's not your field. Don't waste your time."
Zhang Xian smiled and took out a set of high-quality alchemy equipment. "This disciple has long yearned to learn the art of alchemy."

For a cultivator like him without a Fire Spirit Root, wanting to refine pills meant relying on the furnace fire of alchemical equipment. For this reason, Zhang Xian had specially purchased a set of top-grade alchemy tools.
To do good work, one must first sharpen one's tools.

"A waste." The old man clicked his tongue disapprovingly and waved his long sleeve. A book titled True Explanations of the Alchemical Path landed in front of Zhang Xian. "Follow this and refine on your own. Go get a few portions of materials for Fasting Pills from that shelf over there. Come find me again after you've successfully refined some Fasting Pills."
"Understood, Teacher."
Zhang Xian walked confidently toward the medicinal herb shelf. But after just one look, he was dumbfounded.
The shelf was densely packed with hundreds of medicinal herbs; he didn't recognize over half of them!
He had heard names like Purple Spirit Grass, Green Root Fruit, and Cold Mist Grass before, but he simply couldn't identify them.
Seeing Zhang Xian frozen in place, Zhenhai couldn't help but walk over. "Junior Brother, what's wrong?"
Zhang Xian gave an awkward laugh. "Well... Senior Brother, do you recognize which herbs are for the Fasting Pill?"
Zhenhai: "?"
You don't even know the materials for a Fasting Pill?
And you have the nerve to say you want to learn alchemy?
"Haven't you been at Green Wood Peak for quite a while?" Zhenhai said with an incredulous look. "Did Supervisor Liu not teach you to recognize spiritual plants?"
Zhang Xian said righteously, "I learned how to grow spiritual plants, not how to identify medicinal herbs!"
Zhenhai let out a light sigh. "Alright then, I shouldn't have asked you. What you went to Green Wood Peak for is an open secret.
"Do not slander my good name without cause!"
In the end, Zhenhai still helped him gather all the materials and gave a simple explanation of the refining steps.
"Remember, keep the heat steady and your spiritual power even; everyone learned this in the Outer Sect. Oh right, you never spent time in the Outer Sect."
Zhang Xian nodded. "Don't worry, I understand now!"
Zhang Xian confidently started the furnace. Following Zhenhai's guidance, he first used spiritual power to ignite the fire, then added the materials one by one.
Then, he used too much force, causing the flames to surge instantly.
Boom!
After a puff of black smoke, the materials inside the furnace turned directly into charred powder.
The commotion startled several disciples arguing at the next table. They turned to look and were immediately speechless.
"He can blow up a furnace just refining a Fasting Pill? What a weirdo. Whose subordinate is this?"
"Shh... It's that immortal second-generation from Spirit Sword Peak—the one who drowned in a manure pit in that novel."
"Oh? Instead of having fun at Spirit Sword Peak or Green Wood Peak, what's he doing here? We don't have any girls here."
"Stop talking nonsense! Once you refine an Earth-grade pill, won't you have girls and spirit stones aplenty!"
Zhang Xian was unwilling to give up. "It must be a problem with the heat control! Again!"
Zhenhai had an ominous premonition and silently took a few steps back.
This time, Zhang Xian learned his lesson and carefully controlled the heat. Seeing the temperature inside the furnace stabilize, he nodded in satisfaction.
"Next step: infuse spiritual power to harmonize the medicinal properties."
Then, Zhang Xian directly poured in a huge surge of Wood Spirit energy!
Azure Emperor's Rejuvenation Art—activate!
Wood generates Fire!
The previously stable furnace fire instantly went berserk; the alchemy furnace trembled violently!
"Holy shit!" Zhenhai, who had been watching closely, paled and quickly raised a protective barrier.
BOOM——!!!
With a tremendous blast, the alchemy furnace shattered into pieces; violent waves of fire poured out.
The Head Teacher instantly flashed into existence and pressed down with his palm. The erupting flames rapidly contracted until they condensed into a tiny spark and vanished.
The old man looked at Zhang Xian with a dark expression.
Zhang Xian gave an embarrassed smile. "Head Teacher... I can pay compensation."
The old man slowly turned his head. His gaze swept over the terrified disciples around them, then over the large hole in the wall and the scattered medicine shelves.
Real Man Chiyan took a deep breath and raised his hand in a sweeping motion.
"GET OUT!!!"
A wave of energy blasted both Zhang Xian and Zhenhai straight out of Pill Cauldron Peak.
[Shocking! Apprentice at Pill Cauldron Peak detonates top-grade alchemy furnace on-site; attempts to take entire peak down with him!]
[Grievous! Apprentice fined 10,000 sect contribution points for furnace explosion; bankrupted overnight!]
Several pieces of news spread throughout the Yunmiao Sect; countless cultivators were overjoyed and celebrated.
The next day.
Zhenhai took Zhang Xian to Divine Mist Peak to learn talisman-making.
The Supervisor of Divine Mist Peak was an elegant middle-aged man who was quite polite when he saw Zhenhai and even exchanged pleasantries.

"Drawing talismans requires a calm heart, settled qi, and steady brushwork." The Supervisor demonstrated by drawing a Breeze Talisman; the talisman paper moved without wind as spiritual energy flowed smoothly like drifting clouds and flowing water.
Zhang Xian tried to imitate him. Result: Poof! The talisman paper spontaneously combusted and charred.
He calmed himself down and tried again—still charred.
Zhang Xian couldn't even master the most basic talisman after studying all night; both Zhenhai and the Supervisor fell silent.

"Drawing talismans isn't just writing characters; each stroke must be infused with spiritual power; neither brushstroke nor stroke order can be wrong," sighed the Supervisor. If Zhang Xian hadn't paid such high tuition fees, he would have wanted to kick him out already.
Suddenly Zhang Xian understood: Isn't this just charging up talismans?!
The talismans produced by his system were fully charged versions! Drawing his own meant charging them stroke by stroke with spiritual power—utterly exhausting!
"I bid you farewell!" Zhang Xian decisively gave up.
Day three.
"Junior Brother... maybe we should just go watch dancing at Graceful Swan Peak instead," Zhenhai kindly suggested.

"Believe me, Senior Brother! I have great talent for formation arrays! I can casually set up spirit-gathering formations! And my mathematical abilities are extremely high within my small world! I'm sure I can learn formation arrays well!"
A somewhat apprehensive Zhenhai brought Zhang Xian to Star Dipper Peak.
A young-looking Head Teacher was explaining Nine Palaces Eight Trigrams Deduction Technique. The disciples below all looked dazed and unfocused.
Zhang Xian and Zhenhai casually found seats and sat down.
"'Li' is hollow in its center; 'Kan' is full within; 'Dui' is broken above; 'Sun' is severed below..." The Supreme Head Teacher explained patiently...
Zhang Xian persisted for two days but felt like his head was full of multivariate equations and calculus; it throbbed painfully until he felt he couldn't hold on any longer.
"Huu..." Beside him, Zhenhai had already fallen asleep...
The next second—Thwack!—Zhenhai was swatted outside by the Head Teacher!
"Go sleep outside if you want to sleep!"
Zhang Xian quickly helped Zhenhai up and took their leave.

"Drawing talismans requires a calm heart, settled qi, and steady brushwork." The Supervisor demonstrated by drawing a Breeze Talisman; the talisman paper moved without wind as spiritual energy flowed smoothly like drifting clouds and flowing water.
Zhang Xian tried to imitate him.
Result: Poof!
The talisman paper spontaneously combusted and charred.
He calmed himself down and tried again—still charred.
Zhang Xian couldn't even master the most basic talisman after studying all night; both Zhenhai and the Supervisor fell silent.
"Drawing talismans isn't just writing characters; each stroke must be infused with spiritual power; neither brushstroke nor stroke order can be wrong," sighed the Supervisor.
If Zhang Xian hadn't paid such high tuition fees, he would have wanted to kick him out already.
Suddenly Zhang Xian understood: Isn't this just charging up talismans?!
The talismans produced by his system were fully charged versions!
Drawing his own meant charging them stroke by stroke with spiritual power—utterly exhausting!
"I bid you farewell!" Zhang Xian decisively gave up.
Day three.
"Junior Brother... maybe we should just go watch dancing at Graceful Swan Peak instead," Zhenhai kindly suggested.
"Believe me, Senior Brother!
I have great talent for formation arrays!
I can casually set up spirit-gathering formations!
And my mathematical abilities are extremely high within my small world!
I'm sure I can learn formation arrays well!"
A somewhat apprehensive Zhenhai brought Zhang Xian to Star Dipper Peak.
A young-looking Head Teacher was explaining Nine Palaces Eight Trigrams Deduction Technique.
The disciples below all looked dazed and unfocused.
Zhang Xian and Zhenhai casually found seats and sat down.
"'Li' is hollow in its center; 'Kan' is full within; 'Dui' is broken above; 'Sun' is severed below..." The Supreme Head Teacher explained patiently...
Zhang Xian persisted for two days but felt like his head was full of multivariate equations and calculus; it throbbed painfully until he felt he couldn't hold on any longer.
"Huu..." Beside him, Zhenhai had already fallen asleep...
The next second—Thwack!—Zhenhai was swatted outside by the Head Teacher!
"Go sleep outside if you want to sleep!"
Zhang Xian quickly helped Zhenhai up and took their leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 53 Simply Unconscionable
paragraphs: Their trip to Divine Mist Peak left both men feeling rather defeated. It took several days for them to recover before Zhang Xian received another message from Zhenhai:
"There's an evening class at Heavenly Puppet Peak tonight; I won't be going myself. Someone will receive you there."

Under the moonlight, following the directions led him towards where evening classes were held on Heavenly Puppet Peak. A massive vermilion archway stood at its entrance, bearing eight large characters inscribed horizontally across its plaque:
Heavenly Puppets Command Fate / Ten Thousand Mechanisms Return To Their Origin

On either side stood two lifelike humanoid puppets: the left one was a thousand-armed Guanyin with kind, benevolent features, while the right one was a three-headed, eight-armed Vajra guardian deity glaring fiercely.
"What are you doing standing at the entrance, Junior Brother?"

A voice as warm and smooth as jade came from behind him. Turning around, he saw a handsome man dressed in pure white clothes smiling at him. His features were picturesque, lips red and teeth white—devastatingly handsome, comparable even to Xuanwei from the small world...
Cupping his hands in salute, he said, "I am Zhang Xian from Spirit Sword Peak, here to attend class."
The handsome guy gestured invitingly, saying, "Please follow me, Junior Brother."
Following him through the archway, the scene transformed immediately, leaving Zhang Xian stunned by the sight before his eyes.

The hall inside was bustling and crowded, more like a huge plaza than a classroom. Cultivators gathered in twos and threes; some were adjusting puppet joints, some combing puppet hair, and some were even hugging puppets and whispering secrets.

Most eye-catching were the various figures moving among them: all handsome men and beautiful women, including styles with black stockings and long legs, white stockings and pure innocence, cute cat ears, and enchanting fox tails... Looking closer, he saw that a white-stocking beauty's knee joint clearly showed visible puppet articulation.
Zhang Xian twitched the corner of his mouth. "This is..."
"This is our daily interaction at Heavenly Puppet Peak," the handsome guy explained, leading Zhang Xian to a quiet desk.
Sitting down, Zhang Xian looked bewildered, asking, "Where is the teacher giving the lecture?"

"The Head Teacher often says the puppet path emphasizes practical experience." The handsome guy smiled and pointed to a figure not far away, saying, "The Head Teacher is there, but he doesn’t give lectures. Class is just a free exchange."

Following his gaze, Zhang Xian saw a tranquil white-haired girl kneeling at a desk in the center of the plaza. Her hair was snow-white, eyes icy, and she wore a blue-white dress, exuding an ethereal aura.
Sensing his gaze, the girl slightly raised her eyes, nodding gently towards him.
So beautiful!
Zhang Xian was somewhat dazed. The girl's appearance was peerless, ethereal, almost perfect!

Pity she's not a Daughter of Destiny. Sitting down and looking around, he noticed many cultivators accompanied by puppets of different styles: some pouring tea, some grinding ink, some massaging their master's back.

Then his gaze was suddenly attracted to a row of girls not far away. They had uniformly oval faces, willow-leaf eyebrows, cherry lips, and pairs of impressive 'truths' seemingly bursting forth. The key point was that they all looked identical. Each sat properly at a desk, while opposite them sat a cultivator pouring his heart out.
Even more surprising, among those cultivators, he saw Green Wood Peak's Senior Brother, Lu Rendin.
"That is..."
"Oh, that is Supervisor Zhiyin," the handsome guy explained. "She specializes in treating heartbreak, unstable Dao hearts, and cultivation anxiety..."
"Why do they look identical?"
"Nonsense, they are all puppets made by the Supervisor!" The handsome guy rolled his eyes.
Zhang Xian stared at the row of girls, thinking, She simultaneously controls a dozen puppets? The Heavenly Puppet Peak Supervisor is indeed awesome...

"Junior Brother seems to also like her, but you need an appointment. Tsk, no wonder you joined Spirit Sword Peak. Everyone is broad-minded, but looking is okay. You cannot fall for them though, since they are all puppets..."
"If the Head Teacher and Supervisor don’t teach, and I want to learn puppet making, who do I find?" Zhang Xian went straight to the point.
"Naturally, find me!" The handsome guy's eyes lit up. He took a humanoid puppet from his storage ring and handed it over, saying, "Here, a free gift, a beginner set!"
Taking the puppet, Zhang Xian looked at the increasingly familiar figure outline and facial features...
"This wouldn’t be..."
"An imitated version of Supervisor Li Fuxi!" The handsome guy said as if it were only natural. "How about it? Resemble her? Took me a month to make!"
Zhang Xian's hand trembled, almost dropping the puppet to the ground.
He carefully looked around, afraid that the next second Li Fuxi would charge in with her sword drawn.
"Do you have others?" he asked, lowering his voice.
The handsome guy revealed an understanding smile, saying, "Want Lin Yinyin or Liu Qingxuan style? But there's no ready stock here; you need to find other senior brothers to commission them...
Zhang Xian: "..."

With his mind swirling with Yun Wanqing's conjecture regarding the 'Bing Jie' reincarnation technique, he said, "Uh, Senior Brother, I think you misunderstand me. I want to make a puppet of my own body type..."
The handsome guy's hand froze mid-air. "Junior Brother is so narcissistic?" he said, looking heartbroken. "Heavenly Puppet Peak, when making puppets, always makes their own ideal type!"
"Or are you into men? That also won’t do, yourself... yourself... oh my, simply unconscionable! I recommend Wangya Head Teacher style; my friend has ready stock..."
Zhang Xian: "..."
Suddenly remembering something, he pointed to the row of busty girls, saying, "You say Heavenly Puppet Peak all make their own ideal type, then Supervisor Zhiyin elder sister—"
"Supervisor's ideal type is a big-breasted cute girl, ah."
"So he himself—"
"Supervisor Wei Miyou, haven't you heard? Height eight feet, waist also eight feet, a genuine macho man," Chen Tiexin said matter-of-factly.
"Then the Head Teacher also—" Zhang Xian glanced at the extraordinarily beautiful white-haired girl, his tone stiffer.
"Head Teacher's ideal type is aloof white hair, ah."

The handsome guy continued, saying, "Head Teacher Su Yuanshen is also male, ah. But it seems nobody has seen his true face; he even attends sect internal meetings using a puppet to attend. Didn’t you know?"
Zhang Xian felt his worldview somewhat shattering. He suddenly pointed at the handsome guy opposite him and said, "Then who are you?"
Before him, the handsome man suddenly flipped his long hair, revealing a charming smile, and said, "I am your Fourth Senior Sister, Chen Tiexin, ah. Eldest Senior Brother didn’t tell you?"
Zhang Xian: "..."
Finally, unable to buy a finished puppet, he directly took a batch of production materials to start from scratch. Recommended by Chen Tiexin, he bought several puppet books:
<Ten Finger Frenzy Dance: From Beginner To Burial>
<How To Make Master Not Recognize Your Puppet Substitute>
<Heavenly Puppet Peak Single Cultivator Self-Rescue Guide>
In the following period, besides bathing and cultivation, he buried his head in diligent study.

chapters.title: Chapter 54 Utterly Unaware of My Financial Power
paragraphs: The day was clear.
Zhang Xian was meticulously carving the joints of a puppet when the communication jade token at his waist suddenly vibrated.
"Come to the evening lecture hall immediately."
It was a message from Li Fuxi.
Has Master returned? Zhang Xian put down the unfinished puppet and hurried to the evening lecture hall.

When he pushed the door open, several people were already standing inside: Senior Brother Zhenhai, Fourth Senior Sister Chen Tiexin, and Lin Yinyin. Li Fuxi sat upright in the main seat, her expression calm, revealing nothing unusual.
This was the entire roster of Spirit Sword Peak. There had been a few other disciples before, but after Li Fuxi's half-year disappearance, they had all transferred to other peaks.
Zhang Xian glanced at Li Fuxi. Her face was exquisitely beautiful, unchanged from when she left, yet her aura seemed even colder and more aloof than before.
Subconsciously, Zhang Xian used his system to check on his master.
[Li Fuxi, Daughter of Destiny (2 points). Current Favorability: 1.]
Zhang Xian's heart sank. The Favorability had risen back up, but her Destiny value was even lower.
"Master." He cupped his hands in salute and stood to the side.
Li Fuxi gave a faint nod. Her gaze swept over everyone before finally settling on Lin Yinyin.
"Lin Yinyin," she began, "I intend to take you as my personal disciple. Are you willing?"
Lin Yinyin was taken aback and instinctively looked toward Zhang Xian.
Zhang Xian gave an almost imperceptible nod.
Lin Yinyin took a deep breath, knelt down, and kowtowed. "This disciple is willing!"
A slight curve touched the corner of Li Fuxi's mouth before it smoothed back into impassivity. "From today onward, you are my final disciple."
She paused, her eyes shifting to Zhenhai, Chen Tiexin, and Zhang Xian. "The three of you must assist her in becoming the Supervisor of Spirit Sword Peak."
The three responded in unison.
Li Fuxi felt a sliver of relief inwardly. She had initially thought the relationship between Zhenhai and Zhang Xian was strained, but she saw them exchanging what seemed like friendly glances.
"Additionally," she looked at Zhang Xian, her tone uncharacteristically gentle, "I will not stand in the way of your relationship with Yinyin."
Lin Yinyin's cheeks flushed slightly pink.

"She has made significant progress during my absence; I presume that is your doing," Li Fuxi said calmly. "However, you must promise me one thing: you are not to engage in dual cultivation with her before she breaks through to the Golden Core stage."
Zhang Xian nodded. "This disciple understands."

He knew Lin Yinyin was nearing minor completion in her cultivation of the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra. If she were to lose her virginity again during this period, all her efforts would be wasted.
Li Fuxi waved her hand. Several faint patterns around Lin Yinyin's waist silently shattered—the Locking Garment Curse was broken.
Lin Yinyin delightedly touched her waist, her eyes sparkling as she looked at Zhang Xian.
"Finally," Li Fuxi's voice remained calm, "I am about to enter closed-door cultivation for a life-or-death breakthrough."
The entire hall was shocked.
"Master!" Zhenhai couldn't help but exclaim.

Li Fuxi raised a hand to stop him. "No need for words. Zhenhai, you have been on Spirit Sword Peak the longest. And Tiexin, I personally brought you into the sect. You are both disciples I trust. From now on, Spirit Sword Peak will rely on you to uphold it until Yinyin matures."

Even the usually lively Chen Tiexin's eyes reddened; the words 'life-or-death closed-door cultivation' hit her too hard. Countless senior cultivators in the Yunmiao Sect had announced such intentions only to vanish into some unknown cave dwelling.
In the end, most died alone in solitude, their bones turning to dust; only a very few ever emerged successfully after their breakthrough.

Even Zhenhai clenched his fists tightly, his knuckles turning white. He knew his master had been stuck at the sixth level of Golden Core for many years and was now attempting to break through to late Golden Core. At their level of cultivation, the more attempts one made at a breakthrough, the lower the success rate became.
It was highly likely that once Master entered seclusion this time, they would never see her again.
Seeing that neither of them replied for a long time—a situation that would normally have angered her—Li Fuxi merely said calmly today, "Your delayed response... does it mean you are unwilling?"
"This disciple respectfully obeys Master's instructions." The two spoke simultaneously, kneeling and kowtowing.
Li Fuxi nodded slightly and turned her gaze to Zhang Xian, who had remained silent beside them. "Zhang Xian, I have no particular instructions for you. Just do not fail Yinyin."
Zhang Xian nodded in acknowledgment.

"Very well, all of you may leave now. From now on, our peak's morning and evening lectures will be merged with those of Po Yun Peak. I still need to prepare for my seclusion and will give you further instructions before I leave."
Suddenly, Zhang Xian stepped forward. "This disciple has a matter requiring a private report to Master."
Li Fuxi frowned. She initially wanted to refuse but, seeing Lin Yinyin's hopeful look, ultimately nodded. "The rest of you may leave."
After everyone else had departed, only master and disciple remained in the evening lecture hall.
"Speak," Li Fuxi said flatly.
Zhang Xian looked directly into her eyes. "During Master's absence... did you fail a breakthrough attempt and damage your Spirit Root?"
Li Fuxi's pupils contracted slightly.
"If not for Beauty Preservation Pills maintaining it... I'm afraid even your current appearance wouldn't be preserved?" Seeing Li Fuxi's expression confirmed his suspicion further.
Li Fuxi stared at him, her tone indifferent. "You presume too much. I will not punish you for this today. You may leave."

Zhang Xian let out a soft sigh. "I possess a unique secret technique that allows me to see through your current condition; it cannot be hidden from me. So when Master speaks of life-or-death closed-door cultivation... you intend to find some deserted cave to eke out another decade or so of life before having Lin Yinyin inherit Spirit Sword Peak? Is that it?"
Li Fuxi's face remained placid; she offered no reply.
Zhang Xian wasted no more words and directly retrieved an item from his system space—the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed.
Li Fuxi's gaze sharpened. "You—
"Consume it; it can repair your Spirit Root," Zhang Xian stated.

A flicker of struggle passed through Li Fuxi's eyes. After a long moment, she shook her head slightly. "Although this Heart-Mending Lotus Seed can protect my Spirit Root... I have already failed three times. Even if my root is protected... its grade will still deteriorate."
Seeing that Zhang Xian had even produced the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed... she no longer concealed the truth.

"This Master has no hope left of breaking through to late Golden Core in this lifetime... What use is clinging to life?" Her voice was calm. "You should take it back instead... I acknowledge your sentiment... I only hope you can keep this secret... I do not wish to see them saddened..."
Zhang Xian did not answer but took out three more items instead:
Immortal Ascension Grass!
Immortal Ascension Pill!
Marrow Cleansing Fruit!
"The lost quality of your Spirit Root can still be restored!"
Li Fuxi was utterly stunned!
Any one of these heavenly treasures would be enough to make high-level cultivators fight tooth and nail for them... yet Zhang Xian casually produced so many!
"This... is too precious..." She admitted it—she was tempted!

"Precious? Master may be utterly unaware of my financial power," Zhang Xian chuckled lightly. "I control all resources within an entire minor world... What seems immensely valuable to you means little to me."

"I also have my pride," Zhang Xian continued with a smile. "In this life... I've only ever acknowledged you as my Master... If word got out that my Master failed her breakthrough attempt and died sitting in meditation... I'd never be able to show my face again."
Li Fuxi: "..."
After a long while... Li Fuxi managed one sentence: "...I cannot repay this debt."

"You can repay it after breaking through to Nascent Soul," Zhang Xian said directly. "Are you truly content with finding some deserted place to die sitting in meditation? Since you've taken Beauty Preservation Pills... presumably wanting to maintain dignity... why not aim for even greater dignity?"
"But I've already failed three times..."
Suddenly furious, Zhang Xian snapped, "Why are you being so wishy-washy?! Giving up just like that?!"
"I started as a mere mortal without even a Spirit Root! Cultivating False Core techniques! Even now I don't know how I'm supposed to form my Golden Core!"
"And you?! Have you been too sheltered?! Never experienced true despair?! Can't handle this little setback?! What kind of immortal cultivation is that?! You might as well die right now!"
Li Fuxi's chest heaved violently.

"What do you know?!" she retorted sharply. "This Master possesses dual Spirit Roots! My cultivation difficulty is twice yours! Back then, during a martial competition arena match, someone severely injured me! My Golden Core nearly shattered! It hasn't fully recovered even now! Yet still, I didn't give up!"

"If it shattered, then re-condense it anew!" Zhang Xian continued berating her. "Or perhaps you're reluctant to part with your useless Golden Core." He pressed on relentlessly. "After all, just some woman with big breasts and no brains... Yinyin following you truly blinded herself! Right now, I'll go sleep with her! We'll both switch allegiance under Po Yun Peak together!"
"You dare!!!" Enraged beyond measure, Li Fuxi shot up from her seat, fury seeming ready to erupt from within her eyes themselves!
[Ding! Current favorability: 31.]

I still need to prepare for my seclusion and will give you further instructions before I leave."
Suddenly, Zhang Xian stepped forward.
"This disciple has a matter requiring a private report to Master."
Li Fuxi frowned.
She initially wanted to refuse but, seeing Lin Yinyin's hopeful look, ultimately nodded.
"The rest of you may leave."
After everyone else had departed, only master and disciple remained in the evening lecture hall.
"Speak," Li Fuxi said flatly.
Zhang Xian looked directly into her eyes.
"During Master's absence... did you fail a breakthrough attempt and damage your Spirit Root?"
Li Fuxi's pupils contracted slightly.
"If not for Beauty Preservation Pills maintaining it...
I'm afraid even your current appearance wouldn't be preserved?" Seeing Li Fuxi's expression confirmed his suspicion further.
Li Fuxi stared at him, her tone indifferent.
"You presume too much.
I will not punish you for this today.
You may leave."
Zhang Xian let out a soft sigh.
"I possess a unique secret technique that allows me to see through your current condition; it cannot be hidden from me.
So when Master speaks of life-or-death closed-door cultivation... you intend to find some deserted cave to eke out another decade or so of life before having Lin Yinyin inherit Spirit Sword Peak?
Is that it?"
Li Fuxi's face remained placid; she offered no reply.
Zhang Xian wasted no more words and directly retrieved an item from his system space—the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed.
Li Fuxi's gaze sharpened.
"You—
"Consume it; it can repair your Spirit Root," Zhang Xian stated.
A flicker of struggle passed through Li Fuxi's eyes.
After a long moment, she shook her head slightly.
"Although this Heart-Mending Lotus Seed can protect my Spirit Root...
I have already failed three times.
Even if my root is protected... its grade will still deteriorate."
Seeing that Zhang Xian had even produced the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed... she no longer concealed the truth.
"This Master has no hope left of breaking through to late Golden Core in this lifetime...
What use is clinging to life?" Her voice was calm.
"You should take it back instead...
I acknowledge your sentiment...
I only hope you can keep this secret...
I do not wish to see them saddened..."
Zhang Xian did not answer but took out three more items instead:
Immortal Ascension Grass!
Immortal Ascension Pill!
Marrow Cleansing Fruit!
"The lost quality of your Spirit Root can still be restored!"
Li Fuxi was utterly stunned!
Any one of these heavenly treasures would be enough to make high-level cultivators fight tooth and nail for them... yet Zhang Xian casually produced so many!
"This... is too precious..." She admitted it—she was tempted!
"Precious?
Master may be utterly unaware of my financial power," Zhang Xian chuckled lightly.
"I control all resources within an entire minor world...
What seems immensely valuable to you means little to me."
"I also have my pride," Zhang Xian continued with a smile.
"In this life...
I've only ever acknowledged you as my Master...
If word got out that my Master failed her breakthrough attempt and died sitting in meditation...
I'd never be able to show my face again."
Li Fuxi: "..."
After a long while...
Li Fuxi managed one sentence: "...I cannot repay this debt."
"You can repay it after breaking through to Nascent Soul," Zhang Xian said directly.
"Are you truly content with finding some deserted place to die sitting in meditation?
Since you've taken Beauty Preservation Pills... presumably wanting to maintain dignity... why not aim for even greater dignity?"
"But I've already failed three times..."
Suddenly furious, Zhang Xian snapped, "Why are you being so wishy-washy?!
Giving up just like that?!"
"I started as a mere mortal without even a Spirit Root!
Cultivating False Core techniques!
Even now I don't know how I'm supposed to form my Golden Core!"
"And you?!
Have you been too sheltered?!
Never experienced true despair?!
Can't handle this little setback?!
What kind of immortal cultivation is that?!
You might as well die right now!"
Li Fuxi's chest heaved violently.
"What do you know?!" she retorted sharply.
"This Master possesses dual Spirit Roots!
My cultivation difficulty is twice yours!
Back then, during a martial competition arena match, someone severely injured me!
My Golden Core nearly shattered!
It hasn't fully recovered even now!
Yet still, I didn't give up!"
"If it shattered, then re-condense it anew!" Zhang Xian continued berating her.
"Or perhaps you're reluctant to part with your useless Golden Core." He pressed on relentlessly.
"After all, just some woman with big breasts and no brains...
Yinyin following you truly blinded herself!
Right now, I'll go sleep with her!
We'll both switch allegiance under Po Yun Peak together!"
"You dare!!!" Enraged beyond measure, Li Fuxi shot up from her seat, fury seeming ready to erupt from within her eyes themselves!
[Ding!
Current favorability: 31.]

chapters.title: Chapter 55 I Don’t Like Short Ones
paragraphs: Looking at the system notification showing increased Favorability points, Zhang Xian knew he had already secured victory in this round.
Looking upon Li Fuxi’s furious expression, Zhang Xian merely found it somewhat amusing.
Hah! A woman saying one thing and meaning another. Her mouth refuses, yet her Favorability is quite honest indeed.
He showed absolutely no fear whatsoever, meeting her glare with a head-on confrontation. "Young master grew up scaring others since childhood... there is nothing I do not dare to do!"
Finally, after taking a deep breath herself, the violent spiritual energy surrounding Li Fuxi's body gradually calmed down.

"This Master won’t fall for your provocation tactics," she stated coolly, sitting back down, her voice regaining its usual aloofness. "This Master accepts your gifts... and will definitely repay you at a future date."
"These are merely apprentice filial piety towards Master... Master needn’t repay anything... just treat Yinyin and myself better in the future, that is enough."

Li Fuxi was not stupid; she knew she owed an immense debt of gratitude towards Zhang Xian. Her beautiful eyes fixed upon him. "Master naturally has her own considerations... regardless, this time I owe you greatly."
[Ding! Gifting Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed successful. Return: Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed x100.]
[Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity. Can serve as the primary medicinal ingredient for treating Spirit Root soul damage.]
[Ding! Gifting Immortal Ascension Grass successful. Return: Immortal Ascension Grass x100.]
[Immortal Ascension Grass: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity. Direct consumption has a probability of improving Spirit Root quality. Effect decreases with repeated consumption.]
[Ding! Gifting Immortal Ascension Pill successful. Triggered return. Return: Immortal Ascension Pill x100.]
[Immortal Ascension Pill: Earth-grade pill, Epic-level pill. After consumption, can greatly improve cultivator's Spirit Root quality. Effect decreases with repeated consumption.]
[Ding! Gifting Marrow Cleansing Fruit successful. Return: Marrow Cleansing Fruit x100.]
[Marrow Cleansing Fruit: Earth-grade material, Epic-level rarity. Direct consumption can improve Spirit Root quality. Effect decreases with repeated consumption.]
[Ding! Current favorability: 41.]
Hearing the system's consecutive prompt sounds, Zhang Xian smiled.
Li Fuxi, watching Zhang Xian’s smiling face, suddenly felt he carried a "sense of a conspiracy succeeding."

This apprentice is too extravagant and lavish... even the Yunmiao Sect Leader couldn’t produce such items easily. She recalled rumors of her apprentice using resources heavily to bombard Green Wood Peak. Could it possibly...
Thinking here, her face instantly flushed red hot.
She lightly coughed a few times, suddenly speaking somewhat unnaturally. "I am, after all, your Master. Don't... don't have any improper thoughts."
Words spoken, she immediately regretted them.
What is this? Trying to cover it up only makes it more obvious?
When did Li Fuxi ever need to use such a clumsy way to clarify a relationship?
It must be because Zhang Xian's spending is too lavish, disturbing my Dao heart, which I had clearly already given up on...
Suddenly feeling somewhat nervous, she unconsciously tightened her fists.
"Relax," Zhang Xian said leisurely, his gaze scanning over her body once. "I don't like short ones."
Li Fuxi's pupils contracted sharply.
"ZHANG! XIAN!"
BOOM!

With a loud explosion, a blast of sword qi sent him, along with the furniture, flying directly out the door. In mid-air, Zhang Xian traced a beautiful parabola before landing with a smack on the bluestone slab ten zhang away.
"F*ck!"
The three people waiting outside the evening lecture hall were startled and scrambled to help Zhang Xian up.
"Brother, what happened?" Lin Yinyin was a bit panicked. "What did you do to make Master so angry?"
"Oh my, Junior Brother, you were too impatient! Did you confess to Master because you were afraid you wouldn't have a chance later?"

"Yes, ah, Junior Brother, this is too much! Master is about to enter life-or-death seclusion. At this critical juncture, you still..." Even Zhenhai was a bit anxious; if not for his deep friendship with Zhang Xian, he would have drawn his sword and cut him already.

"It's fine, it's fine. Master is just being tsundere; she'll be fine in a few days." Zhang Xian grimaced in pain as he climbed up, patted the dust off his robes, and even bowed towards the direction of the evening lecture hall before limping away.
Meanwhile, inside the evening lecture hall, Li Fuxi stared blankly at the heavenly treasures.
That bastard disciple runs his mouth without a filter, but he truly saved my life.
Even if he flaunts his wealth, these heavenly treasures aren't something one just gives away casually. He probably just wants to reduce my psychological burden, right?
Hmph, and he deliberately provoked me.
Thinking of this, an indescribable emotion surged in Li Fuxi's heart.
"Impossible," she muttered to herself. "If he really had those kinds of thoughts, just now he wouldn't have..."
Wouldn't have said what again?
Doesn't like short ones?
Li Fuxi's just-calmed spiritual energy showed signs of running wild again.
She hated two things most in her life: one was being told her strength was insufficient, and the second was being called short!
[Ding! Li Fuxi's Favorability towards you -10. Current Favorability: 31.]
The limping Zhang Xian sighed deeply. "I shouldn't have been so cheap with my words; I poked that woman's sore spot. Sigh.

The next day, Li Fuxi didn't mention the life-or-death seclusion again. Spirit Sword Peak's morning and evening classes were still suspended; Li Fuxi merely said she would be in seclusion in the thatched hut for a month.
It seemed she was preparing to repair her Spirit Root and re-nurture her Golden Core.

Although Zhenhai and the others didn't know what had happened, Master not entering life-or-death seclusion was ultimately a good thing. They judged it must be Zhang Xian's doing; for this, both Zhenhai and Chen Tiexin expressed their gratitude separately.
Another month passed. Zhang Xian was still studying puppet techniques when a melodious immortal music suddenly drifted from the horizon.

Zhang Xian looked up out the window and saw a huge flying boat sailing toward Guest Reception Peak. The prow was carved with a spreading blue luan, and from afar, he could vaguely see a character "Cloud." Zhang Xian recognized this veteran flying boat actor at a glance—people from the Cloud Raiment Pavilion had arrived!
Presumably, Pavilion Master Yun is personally delivering the goods. Zhang Xian was a bit excited; this feeling was even more thrilling than picking up his first car in his previous life.

Through a layer of clouds, Zhang Xian saw the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's flying boat slowly docking. Next, the eastern clouds were suddenly dyed a golden red, a rainbow spanned the sky, and flowing lights danced, breaking through the clouds as the sound of immortal music grew even more soaring and distant.
Whoa! Zhang Xian exclaimed in amazement, thinking that Pavilion Master Yun Wanqing's personal arrival carried such prestige; the guest-welcoming special effects were maxed out.
Clearly sitting on the same flying boat, but compared to when I arrived, it's simply heaven and earth.
Such an anomaly attracted disciples from various peaks to watch.
"Did you hear? The Cloud Raiment Pavilion Master is arriving personally!"
"The former number one beauty of the Southern Region? This pomp is huge."
"Of course. Did you see that red flowing light in the sky? That was my Senior Brother Song rehearsing for a month in advance."
"The golden-red special effects in the sky seem to be the handiwork of the Green Wood Peak Chief Seat; it was specially requested by Grand Elder Wangya."
"Hmm, this brings up gossip from hundreds of years ago."
Yunmiao Sect's Guest Reception Peak was decorated with lanterns and colored streamers.
As the flying boat docked, Yun Wanqing emerged wearing a gilded palace dress. A gilded kingfisher-feather phoenix hairpin in her hair accentuated her peerlessly clear and beautiful face.
She descended the steps from the void, her skirt spreading out freely, looking like a true immortal descending.

Before Guest Reception Peak, Real Person Wangya had been waiting for a long time. Dressed in plain white Daoist robes that moved without wind, he exuded an ethereal immortal aura. He looked up at the figure in mid-air, a glimmer of reminiscence in his eyes. "Pavilion Master Yun, we haven't met for many years. The Fairy's grace surpasses the past."
Yun Wanqing lowered her eyes to look at this old friend, a faint smile hanging on the corner of her lips. "Yes, it has been two hundred years."
The disciples standing in attendance around them quietly raised their eyes, their gazes shifting back and forth between the two, sighing secretly in their hearts.
"Truly a talented man and a beautiful woman."
"Pity fate plays tricks on people, otherwise..."
Several younger female cultivators couldn't help but clench their sleeves tightly, shouting silently in their hearts.
"Be together! Be together!"

chapters.title: Chapter 56 I Can’t Wait Any Longer
paragraphs: Elder Wangya personally welcomed Yun Wanqing into the main hall and invited her to take the seat of honor.

Inside the hall, not only was Elder Wangya present to accompany her, but several other elders, including Liu Huaigu, the head of Green Wood Peak, were also there, demonstrating the Yunmiao Sect's high regard.

Listening to their conversation, Liu Huaigu found it somewhat dull and sent a voice transmission to a beautiful female elder beside him. "Zhiyin, I was wondering why he didn't attend the Pill Appreciation Conference. Turns out he was waiting here for Pavilion Master Yun."

The beauty gently fanned herself with a round fan, her figure ample and striking. It was none other than Wei Miyou, the Supervisor of Heavenly Puppet Peak. Of course, this time it was his puppet, Sister Zhiyin, attending in his stead.

Zhiyin chuckled as she transmitted her reply. "What do you know, you old fool? Elder Wangya contacting Yun Wanqing is a no-lose situation for him. Either he gets his wish and wins the beauty's heart, or his Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra advances further."
As she spoke, her gaze fell upon Yun Wanqing, and she praised, "Truly worthy of being called the Southern Region's number one beauty. It seems I need to update this appearance of mine again."
Liu Huaigu shot her a disdainful glance. "Disgusting."
Zhiyin retorted sharply, "Stuffy old fool!"
Liu Huaigu sneered. "Calling me old? Aren't you just as ancient? Do you really think you're Sister Zhiyin? Pah!"

Sister Zhiyin remained unperturbed and continued her counterattack. "You have the nerve to say that about me? You're the one constantly urging your own daughter to seduce others. It's spread all across the seventy-two peaks! You'd throw away all dignity for a bit of resources!"
"Damn you! Let's settle this one-on-one!"
"One-on-one it is! After this meeting ends, I'll unleash all fourteen of my puppets and beat the crap out of you!"
On the other side, Wangya sat facing Yun Wanqing, completely unaware that his sect's elders were already at each other's throats.
"To what do we owe the pleasure of Pavilion Master Yun's visit to the Yunmiao Sect today?" Wangya asked gently.
Yun Wanqing smiled slightly, her tone polite. "After all, the Yunmiao Sect is also a valued partner of ours. A visit was long overdue."
Wangya nodded and summoned a steward. "Isn't there still a final payment outstanding from our transaction with the Cloud Raiment Pavilion?"

The steward nodded. "Yes, Elder Wangya. According to custom, we settle the final payment within three years after goods are delivered to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion. Previously, Commander-in-Chief Yun handled these matters with me."
Wangya waved his hand grandly. "Since Pavilion Master Yun is here in person today, let's settle it now."
Looking at Wangya's carefree smiling face, the steward initially wanted to object but thought better of it. Let him have his moment of satisfaction today. "As you command, Elder!"
Yun Wanqing politely declined a few times but couldn't withstand Wangya's enthusiasm. She instructed someone to go with the steward to handle the final payment.

"Pavilion Master Yun rarely visits. How about we enjoy some tea and discuss cultivation?" Wangya personally poured tea and pushed the cup toward her. "I recall this is your favorite—Jade Firmament Spirit Tea."
Yun Wanqing looked at the teacup before her, momentarily lost in thought. She said softly, "Elder Wangya is mistaken. Actually, I never liked this tea; its taste is too bitter."
Wangya was taken aback.
"I only drank it because I enjoyed accompanying that person while he drank tea," she said calmly, yet her words instantly silenced Wangya.
The atmosphere in the hall subtly froze for a moment.
Yun Wanqing deftly changed the subject. "Actually, I came today for another important matter. I am here to find Zhang Xian."

Wangya was somewhat surprised and casually explained, "Nangong Yao has been training outside for years. Later, he voluntarily went to Spirit Sword Peak. Recently, he has been doing quite well..." He paused before adding, "The minor world behind this child indeed has deep foundations. I just didn't expect you would personally come to see him."
Yun Wanqing shook her head. "I am not his elder."
"Hmm?"
"We interact as peers."
Nearby, Liu Huaigu, who had been trading barbs with Supervisor Zhiyin, immediately pricked up his ears.
Wangya recalled his previous message to Yun Wanqing about Zhang Xian possibly being infatuated with Li Fuxi's beauty and pursuing Liu Qingxuan. He suddenly felt awkward.
"Shall I send a message to summon Zhang Xian?"
"No need for trouble. This palace will go find him personally." Yun Wanqing stood up.
Wangya: "..."
Why did I suddenly feel an inexplicable sense of panic?
Spirit Sword Peak.
Zhang Xian was still inside his hut crafting puppets, spiritual patterns flickering in his hands.
Suddenly, a faint, elegant fragrance wafted in. A woman in palace attire stood smiling at the doorway—it was Yun Wanqing.
"Pavilion Master Yun." Zhang Xian stood up. "Please come in."

Yun Wanqing looked at the puppet that already bore a seventy to eighty percent resemblance to Zhang Xian and praised, "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian is truly studying puppet techniques. Body replacement for rebirth... that was just a casual remark from this palace."
Zhang Xian grinned. "How would I know without trying? Did Pavilion Master Yun come personally just to supervise my puppet crafting?"
A slight curve touched Yun Wanqing's lips. "Of course not. Would you like to see your flying vessel?"
Zhang Xian's eyes lit up. "Now?"
"Now."
"Quickly show me! I can't wait any longer." Zhang Xian rubbed his hands together eagerly.

"Wait. You need your Peak Master to deactivate your peak's protective mountain array first; otherwise, the flying vessel won't be able to deploy properly." Seeing Zhang Xian clearly impatient yet pretending to be calm as he assembled puppets made Yun Wanqing want to laugh.
"Oh! Right!" Zhang Xian immediately took out his communication talisman and sent a message to Zhenhai.
"The Master is in seclusion. The array talisman for the protective mountain array is currently with Senior Brother.
Upon receiving the message, Zhenhai swooshed over on his flying sword immediately. Joining him were Lin Yinyin and Chen Tiexin, both brimming with curiosity.
The group landed in front of Zhang Xian's thatched hut and peered inside comically.
Zhang Xian couldn't help but chuckle and walked out with Yun Wanqing.
The moment they saw Yun Wanqing's appearance and bearing, the other three couldn't help but sigh inwardly; they gained a whole new understanding of the phrase 'a beauty that could overthrow cities.'
Danger!
Lin Yinyin started sounding internal alarms.

The three hurriedly bowed respectfully toward Yun Wanqing as juniors would. Yun Wanqing lightly raised her delicate hand; strands of spiritual energy gently supported them. "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian and I interact as peers; there's no need for such formality."
Oh no! Peers!
She's giving me a warning shot right here! Lin Yinyin—Major Danger!
"Senior Brother, could I trouble you to deactivate the protective mountain array? Pavilion Master Yun has something to give me."
"Oh... oh yes." Zhenhai hastily agreed and fumbled out an array talisman from his storage pouch. He busied himself clumsily for quite a while but still couldn't deactivate it.
No helping it—he had just taken over Spirit Sword Peak affairs and wasn't very proficient yet. After struggling for a bit, beads of sweat even appeared on his forehead.
"Let me do it!"
Before her voice finished echoing, someone had already arrived—another woman of stunning beauty descended beside Zhang Xian. It was Li Fuxi, who had just emerged from seclusion.
Zhang Xian observed that although Li Fuxi's aura seemed slightly diminished compared to before, its intensity had increased significantly—her spiritual energy felt more refined and dense now.
He quickly used his system to check her status:
[Li Fuxi: 72-point Daughter of Destiny. Current Favorability: 31.]
Her foundation must be completely stabilized now, and her favorability increased a bit too, Zhang Xian thought with some satisfaction.
In terms of looks, Li Fuxi was youthful and lovely, each excelling in different ways compared to Yun Wanqing’s mature elegance—she just lost out slightly in height.
"So it’s Fellow Daoist Fuxi. I only recently learned you became Spirit Sword Peak’s Lord. Congratulations," Yun Wanqing seemed familiar with her, smiling as she spoke.
"Nothing worth congratulating. I should thank you instead for sending these two troublesome disciples my way," Li Fuxi’s voice remained flat, betraying no emotion.
Then, with a look of disdain, she took the array talisman from Zhenhai’s hands. Her fingers formed seals; in flashes of light, the barrier enveloping Spirit Sword Peak gradually dissipated.

sentences.text: Elder Wangya personally welcomed Yun Wanqing into the main hall and invited her to take the seat of honor.

Inside the hall, not only was Elder Wangya present to accompany her, but several other elders, including Liu Huaigu, the head of Green Wood Peak, were also there, demonstrating the Yunmiao Sect's high regard.
Listening to their conversation, Liu Huaigu found it somewhat dull and sent a voice transmission to a beautiful female elder beside him.
"Zhiyin, I was wondering why he didn't attend the Pill Appreciation Conference.
Turns out he was waiting here for Pavilion Master Yun."
The beauty gently fanned herself with a round fan, her figure ample and striking.
It was none other than Wei Miyou, the Supervisor of Heavenly Puppet Peak.
Of course, this time it was his puppet, Sister Zhiyin, attending in his stead.
Zhiyin chuckled as she transmitted her reply.
"What do you know, you old fool?
Elder Wangya contacting Yun Wanqing is a no-lose situation for him.
Either he gets his wish and wins the beauty's heart, or his Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra advances further."
As she spoke, her gaze fell upon Yun Wanqing, and she praised, "Truly worthy of being called the Southern Region's number one beauty.
It seems I need to update this appearance of mine again."
Liu Huaigu shot her a disdainful glance.
"Disgusting."
Zhiyin retorted sharply, "Stuffy old fool!"
Liu Huaigu sneered.
"Calling me old?
Aren't you just as ancient?
Do you really think you're Sister Zhiyin?
Pah!"
Sister Zhiyin remained unperturbed and continued her counterattack.
"You have the nerve to say that about me?
You're the one constantly urging your own daughter to seduce others.
It's spread all across the seventy-two peaks!
You'd throw away all dignity for a bit of resources!"
"Damn you!
Let's settle this one-on-one!"
"One-on-one it is!
After this meeting ends, I'll unleash all fourteen of my puppets and beat the crap out of you!"
On the other side, Wangya sat facing Yun Wanqing, completely unaware that his sect's elders were already at each other's throats.
"To what do we owe the pleasure of Pavilion Master Yun's visit to the Yunmiao Sect today?" Wangya asked gently.
Yun Wanqing smiled slightly, her tone polite.
"After all, the Yunmiao Sect is also a valued partner of ours.
A visit was long overdue."
Wangya nodded and summoned a steward.
"Isn't there still a final payment outstanding from our transaction with the Cloud Raiment Pavilion?"
The steward nodded.
"Yes, Elder Wangya.
According to custom, we settle the final payment within three years after goods are delivered to the Cloud Raiment Pavilion.
Previously, Commander-in-Chief Yun handled these matters with me."
Wangya waved his hand grandly.
"Since Pavilion Master Yun is here in person today, let's settle it now."
Looking at Wangya's carefree smiling face, the steward initially wanted to object but thought better of it.
Let him have his moment of satisfaction today.
"As you command, Elder!"
Yun Wanqing politely declined a few times but couldn't withstand Wangya's enthusiasm.
She instructed someone to go with the steward to handle the final payment.
"Pavilion Master Yun rarely visits.
How about we enjoy some tea and discuss cultivation?" Wangya personally poured tea and pushed the cup toward her.
"I recall this is your favorite—Jade Firmament Spirit Tea."
Yun Wanqing looked at the teacup before her, momentarily lost in thought.
She said softly, "Elder Wangya is mistaken.
Actually, I never liked this tea; its taste is too bitter."
Wangya was taken aback.
"I only drank it because I enjoyed accompanying that person while he drank tea," she said calmly, yet her words instantly silenced Wangya.
The atmosphere in the hall subtly froze for a moment.
Yun Wanqing deftly changed the subject.
"Actually, I came today for another important matter.
I am here to find Zhang Xian."
Wangya was somewhat surprised and casually explained, "Nangong Yao has been training outside for years.
Later, he voluntarily went to Spirit Sword Peak.
Recently, he has been doing quite well..." He paused before adding, "The minor world behind this child indeed has deep foundations.
I just didn't expect you would personally come to see him."
Yun Wanqing shook her head.
"I am not his elder."
"Hmm?"
"We interact as peers."
Nearby, Liu Huaigu, who had been trading barbs with Supervisor Zhiyin, immediately pricked up his ears.
Wangya recalled his previous message to Yun Wanqing about Zhang Xian possibly being infatuated with Li Fuxi's beauty and pursuing Liu Qingxuan.
He suddenly felt awkward.
"Shall I send a message to summon Zhang Xian?"
"No need for trouble.
This palace will go find him personally." Yun Wanqing stood up.
Wangya: "..."
Why did I suddenly feel an inexplicable sense of panic?
Spirit Sword Peak.
Zhang Xian was still inside his hut crafting puppets, spiritual patterns flickering in his hands.
Suddenly, a faint, elegant fragrance wafted in.
A woman in palace attire stood smiling at the doorway—it was Yun Wanqing.
"Pavilion Master Yun." Zhang Xian stood up.
"Please come in."
Yun Wanqing looked at the puppet that already bore a seventy to eighty percent resemblance to Zhang Xian and praised, "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian is truly studying puppet techniques.
Body replacement for rebirth... that was just a casual remark from this palace."
Zhang Xian grinned.
"How would I know without trying?
Did Pavilion Master Yun come personally just to supervise my puppet crafting?"
A slight curve touched Yun Wanqing's lips.
"Of course not.
Would you like to see your flying vessel?"
Zhang Xian's eyes lit up.
"Now?"
"Now."
"Quickly show me!
I can't wait any longer." Zhang Xian rubbed his hands together eagerly.
"Wait.

You need your Peak Master to deactivate your peak's protective mountain array first; otherwise, the flying vessel won't be able to deploy properly." Seeing Zhang Xian clearly impatient yet pretending to be calm as he assembled puppets made Yun Wanqing want to laugh.
"Oh!
Right!" Zhang Xian immediately took out his communication talisman and sent a message to Zhenhai.
"The Master is in seclusion.
The array talisman for the protective mountain array is currently with Senior Brother.
Upon receiving the message, Zhenhai swooshed over on his flying sword immediately.
Joining him were Lin Yinyin and Chen Tiexin, both brimming with curiosity.
The group landed in front of Zhang Xian's thatched hut and peered inside comically.
Zhang Xian couldn't help but chuckle and walked out with Yun Wanqing.
The moment they saw Yun Wanqing's appearance and bearing, the other three couldn't help but sigh inwardly; they gained a whole new understanding of the phrase 'a beauty that could overthrow cities.'
Danger!
Lin Yinyin started sounding internal alarms.
The three hurriedly bowed respectfully toward Yun Wanqing as juniors would.
Yun Wanqing lightly raised her delicate hand; strands of spiritual energy gently supported them.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian and I interact as peers; there's no need for such formality."
Oh no!
Peers!
She's giving me a warning shot right here!
Lin Yinyin—Major Danger!
"Senior Brother, could I trouble you to deactivate the protective mountain array?
Pavilion Master Yun has something to give me."
"Oh... oh yes." Zhenhai hastily agreed and fumbled out an array talisman from his storage pouch.
He busied himself clumsily for quite a while but still couldn't deactivate it.
No helping it—he had just taken over Spirit Sword Peak affairs and wasn't very proficient yet.
After struggling for a bit, beads of sweat even appeared on his forehead.
"Let me do it!"
Before her voice finished echoing, someone had already arrived—another woman of stunning beauty descended beside Zhang Xian.
It was Li Fuxi, who had just emerged from seclusion.
Zhang Xian observed that although Li Fuxi's aura seemed slightly diminished compared to before, its intensity had increased significantly—her spiritual energy felt more refined and dense now.
He quickly used his system to check her status:
[Li Fuxi: 72-point Daughter of Destiny.
Current Favorability: 31.]
Her foundation must be completely stabilized now, and her favorability increased a bit too, Zhang Xian thought with some satisfaction.
In terms of looks, Li Fuxi was youthful and lovely, each excelling in different ways compared to Yun Wanqing’s mature elegance—she just lost out slightly in height.
"So it’s Fellow Daoist Fuxi.
I only recently learned you became Spirit Sword Peak’s Lord.
Congratulations," Yun Wanqing seemed familiar with her, smiling as she spoke.
"Nothing worth congratulating.
I should thank you instead for sending these two troublesome disciples my way," Li Fuxi’s voice remained flat, betraying no emotion.
Then, with a look of disdain, she took the array talisman from Zhenhai’s hands.
Her fingers formed seals; in flashes of light, the barrier enveloping Spirit Sword Peak gradually dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 57 This Overconfident Woman
paragraphs: "I'd like to see what requires deactivating our protective mountain array," Li Fuxi said calmly.
Yun Wanqing smiled without answering and gracefully raised her hand.

A massive flying vessel abruptly materialized above Spirit Sword Peak. Its hull was ink-black; its bow was carved with overlapping mountain ranges, while cloud patterns flowed along its stern. The entire vessel resembled a mobile celestial palace. Though seemingly smaller than the Cloud Raiment Pavilion’s ship overall, it appeared even more exquisite.
"Holy crap!"
"So majestic!"
"As expected, money lets you do anything—even getting the Number One Beauty herself to make personal deliveries!"
"Dammit, Zhang Xian, you old thief."
Disciples from various peaks gazed distantly at the vessel hovering mid-air; they exclaimed while looking up, their eyes filled with shock and envy.
Yun Wanqing smiled slightly towards Zhang Xian and the others. "Come aboard and take a look."

They stepped onto the flying vessel. The deck, paved with spiritual jade, felt warm and smooth like fine fat underfoot. Spiritual patterns shimmered all around—clearly, every inch was meticulously crafted.

"This flying vessel is only half the size of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion’s one but is more fully functional," Yun Wanqing explained. "Mine is more symbolic—large in size—but this one is practical, stronger, faster, and has lower consumption."

She led the tour while explaining: "The vessel has a built-in spirit gathering array; daily operation requires five top-grade spirit stones to maintain normal functions, though consumption increases when using other features. It also has pre-installed offensive arrays like spirit gathering cannons, plus extremely strong defensive capabilities: the spiritual energy shield can withstand a full-power strike from a Nascent Soul cultivator."
"The vessel is also equipped with isolation arrays and concealment arrays for hiding aura. It is extremely fast, too: from here to Jade Capital City takes only half a month."

Zhang Xian nodded mentally. From Yunmiao Sect to Jade Capital City spanned nearly the entire Southern Region. A normal Golden Core cultivator flying on a sword would travel fast but still take at least three months; the Cloud Raiment Pavilion’s ship took a month. This speed was doubled.

"Now only the final step is left: it needs Heavenly Puppet Peak Supervisor Wei to activate and enlighten the puppet crews. Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian just needs to control the captain role among them, and the ship can sail."
Supervisor Wei?
Zhang Xian finally realized and laughed. "Didn’t know Sister Zhiyin had skills like this."
Li Fuxi snorted coldly. "Supervisor Wei’s multitasking secret technique is unparalleled in the Southern Region; only he can arrange such large-scale puppet teams."
Yun Wanqing nodded, then told Zhang Xian, "This ship is already pre-loaded with a thousand top-grade spirit stones, which should last several years; remember to replace them when used up."
Zhang Xian quickly said, "How can that be? I heard from Yun Qi you fronted a lot of money for the ship too; I should pay you."
Yun Wanqing shook her head. "No need. Actually, calculating it, I owe you."
Huh? The others’ gossip souls blazed fiercely.
"That won’t do; separate matters are separate," Zhang Xian said, reaching to take out spirit stones.
"You doing this means looking down on me and not treating me as a friend," Yun Wanqing's tone brooked no refusal. "Say more, and I’ll get angry!"
Others: "..."
Lin Yinyin internally had a frantic monologue: Oh no! This rich lady is targeting me! My position is threatened!
Danger!!
Zhang Xian’s lines were snatched first by Yun Wanqing, so he could only stand there awkwardly.
Yun Wanqing suddenly turned, facing Li Fuxi. "Peak Master Fuxi, I have some private matters to discuss alone with Zhang Xian."
Li Fuxi humphed, glanced at Zhang Xian with a smile that wasn't a smile, then waved her sleeve. Spiritual energy swept up Lin Yinyin, Zhenhai, and Chen Tiexin, directly taking them off the ship.
"Master! Wait! I haven’t seen enough yet!" Lin Yinyin’s struggling voice faded away.
Yun Wanqing raised her hand and pointed; the ship's protective grand array instantly activated, isolating it from outside observation.
The whole sect erupted!
"They activated the protective grand array!"
"Holy crap! What are they doing?"
"Shocking! Southern Region's former Number One Beauty, Yun Wanqing, is having a private meeting with Zhang Xian on the flying vessel! Right atop Spirit Sword Peak under everyone’s watchful eyes!"
Elder Wangya stood at Guest Reception Peak, utterly dumbfounded, the teacup in his hand clattering to the ground.
Other elders cast sympathetic glances.
Just then, a clear, cold female voice suddenly rang out. "Let me see, look."

Everyone turned and saw a woman in blue-white robes with white hair who had unknowingly appeared in front of the elders' group. Her face was as exquisite as a painting—it was distinctly Heavenly Puppet Peak Master Su Yuanshen’s puppet.
"Elder Su Ling." The elders were shocked. "How come you came down the mountain?"

Su Ling was the name of this puppet. In the Yunmiao Sect, seeing a puppet meant one must call it by the puppet's name; it was common sense, just like with Sister Zhiyin. Calling it wrong invited a brutal beating—a lesson learned through blood and tears.
Su Ling said calmly, "Here to gossip."
Su Ling looked toward the direction of Spirit Sword Peak, her tone placid. "They activated the protective grand array, so I can’t hear them talking anymore, so I came to see and look."
Elders: "..."

"Heard Pavilion Master Yun earlier said this flying vessel was a gift to that junior and also said she owed him." Su Ling continued. "Oh, they entered the inner cabin. Now Yun Wanqing is pouring tea."
The elders were sweating. Su Ling, Head Teacher, don’t say it in such detail, ah. Didn't you notice Wangya's figure getting more and more desolate?
Liu Huaigu truly couldn't bear it and said, "Elder Su Ling, just the key points are fine."

Su Ling turned back and looked at him. "Huaigu, I remember this junior is currently interacting with the Qingxuan girl, right? He seems somewhat ambiguous with Pavilion Master Yun. You should go knock some sense into him."
"Ah! That is not necessary. They are in free love; this old man doesn't interfere much."
"Oh? Often see you tell the Qingxuan girl, letting her—"
"Ahem, Elder Su is getting off topic. Let’s watch the flying vessel." Liu Huaigu's old face flushed red.

Inside the flying vessel's inner cabin, Yun Wanqing and Zhang Xian sat opposite each other. Yun Wanqing poured a cup of tea and handed it to Zhang Xian, saying with sincere gratitude, "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian, thank you for the pill gift."
Zhang Xian waved his hand and laughed. "Small matter, no need to take it to heart."

Yun Wanqing shook her head, her tone solemn. "Fellow Daoist Zhang Xian need not be so humble; this Immortal Ascension Pill's value is immense. Now the Lingxu Sect is hosting a Pill Appreciation Conference. The Great Xia Dynasty and Treasure Green Workshop are competing for one Immortal Ascension Pill, and the bidding has reached a white-hot stage."

"One Immortal Ascension Pill means the possibility of a Golden Core peak cultivator advancing to Nascent Soul." She sighed softly. "My father is currently taking it. If he achieves Nascent Soul, then the Cloud Raiment Pavilion will ascend to another level."
Zhang Xian was stunned. "You didn't eat it yourself?"

"The Immortal Ascension Pill is good, but giving it to my father has a greater effect for the family. He has been stuck at the Golden Core peak for over three hundred years already. I have no extravagant hope of advancing to Nascent Soul myself."
Zhang Xian was silent for a moment, then suddenly fished out another Immortal Ascension Pill from his robe and handed it over. "Then this one is for you."
Yun Wanqing's pupils contracted, and she quickly retreated a step. "This... how can I? Two... giving both to me... absolutely cannot accept!"
She secretly thought, Wangya's message said he is somewhat lecherous. Him giving both Immortal Ascension Pills... mostly likely infatuated with my beauty. Must quickly cut off his thoughts.
[Ding! Yun Wanqing favorability towards you -2. Current favorability: 18.]
Zhang Xian: "?"
Damn, she thinks I am trying to pursue her, right? This overconfident woman.
