"Just average," Liu Qingxuan teased, laughing behind her hand.
"Actually, the disguise is unnecessary.
Even if you hide your face, those familiar with you can recognize your spiritual fluctuations.
You should use arrays to mask your presence instead."
For cultivators, beauty was common, and Zhang Xian was indeed only 'somewhat' handsome by those standards.
Yet, as she looked at his easy smile, Liu Qingxuan found him increasingly pleasant to be around.
"Haha," Zhang Xian laughed.
He couldn't easily explain that he was hiding from Nan Gongyao, who had known him as a mere mortal.
A gentle night breeze stirred, lifting strands of Liu Qingxuan’s hair and carrying a faint, sweet fragrance toward him.
"Zhang Xian," she asked, her voice dropping to a whisper.
"Why are you so good to me?"
Zhang Xian paused, then smiled warmly.
"Because you deserve it, Supervisor Liu.
You are sincere and kind.
You didn't look down on me because I came from an outer peak or because I practiced False Core techniques."
"Is that all?" Her voice was so quiet it nearly vanished into the wind.
"Do you not want anything in return?"
He gazed out at the sea of clouds in the distance.
"Supervisor Liu, when you make a friend, do you immediately calculate the profit?
I follow my heart.
If it feels right, I do it."
He turned back to her, a playful glint in his eyes.
"Besides, you are very beautiful.
It makes me happy to be friends with a beautiful lady."
"Smooth talker," she replied, laughing softly.
A sense of peace settled over her, and deep within her heart, a long-silent string began to vibrate.

chapters.title: Chapter 66 The Advantage Is Mine
paragraphs: Inside the hot spring room, Li Fuxi soaked in the misty waters, her entire body submerged in a state of deep relaxation. Through the hazy steam, her snow-white skin took on a faint pink hue, and her long hair cascaded like a dark waterfall, floating gently on the water's surface.

The sounds of conversation and laughter from the deck, though muffled by the cabin's barrier formation, still carried a sense of irritating joy. Li Fuxi unconsciously pricked up her ears, trying to decipher the muffled voices.
"So good..."
"Reward..."
"Pretty... happy..."
The fragmented words drifted to her, making her chest tighten with a strange, prickly sensation.
"He really is a little lecher. Even with Yinyin already..." Li Fuxi irritably stirred the water, sending ripples splashing against the jade walls.
"Forget it. It's just conversation; they haven't overstepped." She forced herself to remain stoic, sinking deeper into the pool to focus on absorbing the potent essence of the spiritual liquid.

Several days later, the flying vessel descended before the mountain gates of the Muling Sect. As Zhang Xian and his party disembarked, they found dozens of elders, led by the Sect Leader himself, already lined up in a formal welcome.

"Esteemed fellow Daoists from the Yunmiao Sect, you have traveled far! We apologize for not meeting you further out!" The Sect Leader was a young-looking man in blue robes named Lu Qing, his expression a mask of practiced amiability.

As Zhang Xian, Li Fuxi, and Liu Qingxuan stepped onto the ground, a wave of astonished murmurs swept through the gathered crowd. Both women were breathtaking beauties, their grace unmatched in this region.
However, what truly surprised the Muling Sect was that the unassuming middle-aged man with the lowest cultivation level seemed to be the one subtly taking the lead.
"I am Zhang Xian. Greetings, Sect Leader Lu," Zhang Xian said, performing a polite cupped-fist salute.

The trio had done their homework. Lu Qing was at the third layer of the Golden Core stage and had held his position for over two hundred years. Most importantly, he had briefly studied under Liu Huaigu at Green Wood Peak.

The Muling Sect had been in a state of deep apprehension since receiving advance word of this visit. After some discussion, Zhang Xian had agreed to handle the negotiations, while Liu Qingxuan and Li Fuxi provided the necessary prestige and muscle.
"Greetings to you three True Persons." Lu Qing’s posture was remarkably humble. He showed no disdain toward Zhang Xian’s Foundation Establishment status; the Yunmiao Sect’s authority was absolute.
Lu Qing immediately tried to establish rapport with Liu Qingxuan. "This student pays respects to Supervisor Liu. How has Teacher Huaigu been recently?"
"My father is in good health. Thank you for your concern," Liu Qingxuan replied with a slight, formal nod.
"This student is ashamed," Lu Qing sighed. "Please, honored True Persons, let us proceed to the main hall."
Inside the hall, fruit tea was served. Zhang Xian’s party took the seats of honor on the left, while Lu Qing and his elders sat on the right.

Following cultivation world traditions, they began with long stretches of small talk and anecdotes. Lu Qing and his elders showered Zhang Xian with extravagant praise, nearly describing him as an immortal descended from the heavens.

Li Fuxi loathed socializing, and Liu Qingxuan was too shy for such games. Fortunately, Zhang Xian was a veteran of the social arts. He returned the flattery with a stream of his own compliments, suggesting Lu Qing had the bearing of a future Nascent Soul master.
The atmosphere became so jovial it seemed they might become sworn brothers on the spot. Only after the two women began to feel drowsy did Lu Qing finally steer the conversation toward business.
"Ahem." Lu Qing let out a heavy sigh. "It is a pity our sect produced a few scoundrels who disrupted the friendship between our sects—truly a disgrace to the cultivation world."
Zhang Xian sat up straight. "Bring that beast in here!" Lu Qing barked.
Two disciples escorted a haggard man into the hall. He was the survivor of the trio that had attacked the temple.
"The sinful disciple is here!" the Sect Leader shouted. "Confess your crimes before the seniors of Yunmiao Sect!"
The disciple fell prostrate, trembling. "This junior... this junior knows he was wrong..."
Zhang Xian confirmed the man’s face against the portrait provided by Li Miaoyin. He stood up and began a slow, deliberate circle around the kneeling man.
"First question: why did you attack?"
"It... it was my master," the disciple stammered. "He thought those cultivators had treasures... and he coveted the female cultivator's beauty. He thought no one would find out in a minor world."
"Hmph! To think we produced such scum!" a white-haired elder shouted. This was the second Golden Core of the sect and the master of the deceased attacker.
"Second question," Zhang Xian continued. "Returning from that world costs thirty mid-grade spirit stones. Why go there at all?"
"Master wanted to trade with mortals... buying materials at low prices to recoup costs. He took us along to learn the trade."
This was a common, if illegal, practice. Cultivators often exploited minor worlds for resources, evading the Southern Region's decrees against interfering in mortal affairs.
"Final question: your master died there. How did you return?"
"I... I used a recall formation array."
"Oh? Those cost ten mid-grade spirit stones," Zhang Xian mocked. "A Qi Refining disciple carrying that kind of wealth? How frugal of you."
Cold sweat poured down the disciple’s face. "The stones were... saved for my future tribulations..."

Zhang Xian fell silent. It was a plausible lie, but a lie nonetheless. Suddenly, the white-haired elder flicked his palm. A burst of energy sent the disciple curling into a ball, screaming as his spiritual roots were shattered.
"I have crippled him," the elder said gravely. "His life is in your hands."
Zhang Xian glanced at his companions and opened their private mental communication channel.
If I decide to fight them now—can we handle it?

I could level this entire sect alone, Li Fuxi’s voice rang in his head, cold and confident. Despite her recent reset, the quality of her Supreme Spirit Root far outstripped these third-rate cultivators.

I am not a fighter, but at the sixth layer of the Golden Core, I can manage, Liu Qingxuan added. But Zhang Xian, are you sure? They seem sincere. Do we really need to slaughter them for the actions of a few?
I'm just weighing our options, Zhang Xian replied. The advantage was firmly his.
"Ahem!" Zhang Xian stood up, his voice echoing through the hall.
"I will take this disciple back with me for further questioning. Does anyone have any objections?"

chapters.title: Chapter 67 Crashed and Burned, Just as Expected
paragraphs: As soon as Zhang Xian finished speaking, the great hall fell into a heavy, suffocating silence.
Usually, such matters were resolved on the spot. The Muling Sect had already adopted a very humble stance. Even if Zhang Xian had killed the man right then and there, no one would have objected.
However, taking the prisoner away was a different matter entirely; it was equivalent to grinding the Muling Sect’s face into the dirt.
"This..." Lu Qing said awkwardly. "Esteemed Zhang Zhenren, perhaps you still have concerns? We could interrogate him right here."

"Oh, I suspect he hasn't told the whole truth," Zhang Xian replied with a thin smile. "I'm a naturally suspicious person, always prone to conspiracy theories. To be honest, I'm on good terms with the people from that minor world. I won't feel at ease until this is thoroughly investigated."

The Golden Core elder spoke up, his voice stern. "After all, he is a disciple of our Muling Sect. It is inappropriate for you to take him. If you are uneasy, stay for a few days. We can interrogate him together."
"Inappropriate? In what way?"
"It conflicts with our regulations," Lu Qing replied. "Disciples must be dealt with by the sect or handed to the city lord of this jurisdiction. This is against protocol. I hope you understand."

Zhang Xian grinned widely. "Sect Leader Lu, you see it yourself. I’ve brought two Supervisors, one of whom is your teacher's daughter. Do us a favor; it's just one disciple. The Yunmiao Sect wouldn't stoop so low as to covet anything from you."
"After all, rules are rigid, but people are flexible. Don't you agree?"
His words carried a sharp edge of arrogance. The elders present bristled with indignation but remained silent, stifled by the Yunmiao Sect's superior status.
Lu Qing’s expression soured. He stared at Zhang Xian for a long moment before shaking his head. "Zhang Zhenren, we have received you with courtesy. Your proposal is rejected."
"Oh?" Zhang Xian looked genuinely surprised. "So little face given?"
"Among the sects of the Southern Region, there is no such precedent," the Golden Core elder admonished. "Though your sect is powerful, you should still know your limits."
"Good! Very good!"

Zhang Xian began to pace. His footsteps seemed to tread upon the hearts of everyone in the room. No one could have imagined that the man who had just been joking about sworn brotherhood could turn so aggressive so quickly.
"Then how about this? I possess a soul-searching secret technique. I'll extract his soul right here and interrogate it. That way, I'll be satisfied. What do you think?"
"Soul-searching!!" The hall erupted in shock.
"That is a forbidden technique of the evil sects!" the Golden Core elder roared, his face turning cold. "It is an abomination! How could a disciple of the Yunmiao Sect know such a thing?"
Evil sect techniques were universally condemned in the Southern Region. If Zhang Xian truly practiced such arts, he was effectively signing his own death warrant.
"Tsk, I just happened to learn it," Zhang Xian said casually. "Whether a technique is evil depends on the user."
He pointed at the kneeling disciple. "He won't survive this anyway. I’ll just search his soul, then the Sect Leader can execute him. The matter ends there."
Upon hearing "soul-searching," the disciple’s face turned ghostly pale. He moved to sever his own heart meridian, but Zhang Xian casually pressed a palm strike down on him, rendering him immobile.
"A Yunmiao Sect disciple practicing evil arts? Does your esteemed sect not care?" Lu Qing stared at Liu Qingxuan, his face dark.
Liu Qingxuan’s heart sank into a panic. If Zhang Xian truly used soul-searching, the six major powers would join forces to eliminate him without negotiation, regardless of his background.

"Of course we care," Li Fuxi spoke up calmly before Liu Qingxuan could find her voice. "If he truly knows soul-searching, I will personally apprehend him and return him to our sect for public judgment."

A playful smile touched Zhang Xian’s lips as he looked at Lu Qing. "Sect Leader, why are you so nervous? If I use the technique, it clears your name while forcing me into exile. It’s a double win for you, isn't it?"
Lu Qing’s expression shifted between suspicion and shock. He forced himself to remain calm. "Hmph! I know you're bluffing! My Muling Sect has a clear conscience! If you dare, search him!"
"Straightforward!" Zhang Xian laughed. He slammed his palm onto the disciple's head and shouted, "Speak! Who ordered you?"
The disciple convulsed. His eyes rolled back into his head, and blood spurted from his nose. Gurgling sounds rose from his throat. "It was... the Sect Leader..."
The hall exploded. The elders were horrified—he actually knew soul-searching? And he was doing it publicly?
Li Fuxi remained seated, but sword energy began to swirl around her. Liu Qingxuan’s knuckles turned white. She was terrified that Zhang Xian had just ruined his life.
Ignoring them, Zhang Xian pressed harder. "Why?"
The disciple sprayed bloody foam. "Uh... Sect Leader wanted... to arrange..."
Before he could finish, Lu Qing and the Golden Core elder moved with explosive killing intent.
"Boom!"

Li Fuxi reacted instantly, an ice-blue barrier flying from her sleeve to protect the disciple. At that exact moment, the sky blazed with golden light. A massive swastika dharma seal enveloped the entire Muling Sect like a celestial prison.
"Amitabha."
A handsome, bald youth in earth-yellow robes strode into the hall. A faint red mark at the corner of his eye gave him a subtly demonic air.
Zhang Xian looked at the massive seal covering the dome. "Really? You're going to fight here? You don't want your sect anymore?"
Lu Qing and the elders said nothing, their spiritual energy reaching a breaking point.
The monk shook his head. "Fellow Daoist, the soul-searching evil technique is intolerable to the Heavenly Dao. This poor monk has come to slay a demon."
He bowed toward Li Fuxi. "Fuxi, it has been a long time."
"Jian Chen, are you the mastermind behind this?" Li Fuxi asked coldly.
"A bright mirror reflects dust, yet remains unstained," the monk recited. "I am merely a passerby slaying a demon."
"All flash, no substance," Zhang Xian rolled his eyes. "Master, who is this bald guy?"
"A loser from Mountain Chan Monastery who fell by my hand.
"Oh, then I’m relieved." Zhang Xian smiled at the tense crowd. "Everyone relax. It's all a misunderstanding."
"Misunderstanding? You are a demon!" the Golden Core elder cursed.
Zhang Xian raised his hand. A voice suddenly emitted from his palm—the exact voice and tone of the disciple: "Sect Leader wanted to arrange..."
"A cheap parlor trick," Zhang Xian mocked. "Since there are no demons here, why don't we all just disperse?"
"You dare mock me!" Lu Qing roared, veins bulging at his temples.
"Ai." Jian Chen sighed.

The golden light intensified. Suddenly, the auras of Lu Qing and the Golden Core elder skyrocketed. They had been concealing their strength; Lu Qing was actually in the mid-Golden Core stage, his power no weaker than Liu Qingxuan’s.
Jian Chen bowed to Li Fuxi, then lunged—not at her, but toward Zhang Xian.
Lu Qing intercepted Liu Qingxuan while the other elder charged Li Fuxi. Li Fuxi’s twin swords shot through the air, repelling the elder while slashing at Jian Chen’s back.
Suddenly, the disciple on the ground erupted in golden light and exploded.
"Boom!"

Zhang Xian summoned a top-grade defensive artifact, but it shattered instantly against the force. At the same time, Jian Chen ignored Li Fuxi’s sword and struck. A golden lotus bloomed in his palm as a Buddhist seal fell from the sky.
The seal struck just as the disciple exploded. Zhang Xian was caught in the center and blasted into dust.
"Zhang Xian!" Liu Qingxuan screamed, tears bursting from her eyes as she struck out in a fit of Hatred.
Li Fuxi’s expression remained stony, but her aura surged. She had wounded Jian Chen, but he laughed through the blood.
"Fuxi, your spiritual roots have improved! And you cultivate the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra... such an excellent furnace technique. I shall gratefully accept your primal yin!"
Li Fuxi’s sword intent pierced the heavens, but Jian Chen’s wounds were bizzarely healing as they fought.
"Lu Qing! Capture the woman!" Jian Chen shouted.

Liu Qingxuan, unskilled in direct combat, was being pushed back by Lu Qing and the other elder. Only the Orange Heart Pendant—a gift from Zhang Xian—protected her. Her heart was filled with grief; the man who gave her the pendant had just been turned to ash.
Suddenly—Rumble! A five-colored spiritual light streaked across the sky like heavenly punishment. It struck the swastika formation with a deafening roar.
The residual force blasted the entire Green Wood Ridge mountain away, leaving only the ruins of the great hall.
As the dust settled, a familiar figure appeared, riding a sword. It was Zhang Xian.
"So awesome. The formation still didn't shatter?"
He shook his head, his tone helpless. "You two are truly unreliable. You both said you had this handled, and now look—crashed and burned, just as expected."

Jian Chen bowed to Li Fuxi, then lunged—not at her, but toward Zhang Xian.
Lu Qing intercepted Liu Qingxuan while the other elder charged Li Fuxi.
Li Fuxi’s twin swords shot through the air, repelling the elder while slashing at Jian Chen’s back.
Suddenly, the disciple on the ground erupted in golden light and exploded.
"Boom!"
Zhang Xian summoned a top-grade defensive artifact, but it shattered instantly against the force.
At the same time, Jian Chen ignored Li Fuxi’s sword and struck.
A golden lotus bloomed in his palm as a Buddhist seal fell from the sky.
The seal struck just as the disciple exploded.
Zhang Xian was caught in the center and blasted into dust.
"Zhang Xian!" Liu Qingxuan screamed, tears bursting from her eyes as she struck out in a fit of Hatred.
Li Fuxi’s expression remained stony, but her aura surged.
She had wounded Jian Chen, but he laughed through the blood.
"Fuxi, your spiritual roots have improved!
And you cultivate the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra... such an excellent furnace technique.
I shall gratefully accept your primal yin!"
Li Fuxi’s sword intent pierced the heavens, but Jian Chen’s wounds were bizzarely healing as they fought.
"Lu Qing!
Capture the woman!" Jian Chen shouted.
Liu Qingxuan, unskilled in direct combat, was being pushed back by Lu Qing and the other elder.
Only the Orange Heart Pendant—a gift from Zhang Xian—protected her.
Her heart was filled with grief; the man who gave her the pendant had just been turned to ash.
Suddenly—Rumble!
A five-colored spiritual light streaked across the sky like heavenly punishment.
It struck the swastika formation with a deafening roar.
The residual force blasted the entire Green Wood Ridge mountain away, leaving only the ruins of the great hall.
As the dust settled, a familiar figure appeared, riding a sword.
It was Zhang Xian.
"So awesome.
The formation still didn't shatter?"
He shook his head, his tone helpless.
"You two are truly unreliable.
You both said you had this handled, and now look—crashed and burned, just as expected."

chapters.title: Chapter 68 Master, Stop Rubbing
paragraphs: Seeing Zhang Xian safe and sound, Liu Qingxuan was so moved that tears fell, while a faint, almost imperceptible curve lifted the corner of Li Fuxi’s mouth.
Lu Qing was furious. "You're still not dead?"
Zhang Xian grinned. "Sect Leader Lu, I helped you sever your worldly ties just now. You really should thank me."

As he spoke, he flipped his palm to retrieve the core of the shattered puppet. He continued, "The Muling Sect should only have its reserve positions left now. I may have accidentally harmed some innocent disciples; I hope you can find it in your hearts to be magnanimous."

"Your puppet techniques have truly broadened this humble monk’s horizons." Jian Chen raised an eyebrow. He had never expected this seemingly ordinary disciple to possess such bizarre methods and decisive killing intent, wiping out the Muling Sect’s foundation with a single blast.
"You seek death!" The Golden Core elder and the others were enraged to the point of madness. Seeing their sect's legacy destroyed in an instant, they charged directly at Zhang Xian.
Zhang Xian pinched several spirit talismans between his fingertips. With a flick of his wrist, heavenly thunder descended.
"Boom!"
The Golden Core elder hastily summoned his protective spiritual light. However, three magic swords hidden behind Zhang Xian had already flown to his side, exploding in rapid succession.
"Ah!"

Amidst the screams, the Golden Core elder was severely injured and forced back. Seizing the opportunity, Li Fuxi separated one of her swords. In a flash of golden light, it pierced the elder’s dantian, shattering his Golden Core. The golden light didn't slow down, reaping the lives of the remaining Foundation Establishment elders in a single sweep.
"Sect Leader Lu, now your Muling Sect is down to just you!" Zhang Xian stood beside Liu Qingxuan and spoke calmly.

Lu Qing stared at him fixedly. In this dire moment, he became eerily calm. His fingers formed seals, and countless Green Wood Thorns materialized around him. "The Swastika Grand Array is not yet broken; the final victor is still unknown."

On the other side, Jian Chen’s earth-yellow monk robes surged like waves, his aura climbing to the seventh level of the Golden Core. Zhang Xian glanced at Li Fuxi. Her eyes were clear and focused, showing no sign of disorder.

A few strands of her black hair stirred in the sword energy, brushing against her porcelain-white cheek, but she didn't even flutter an eyelash. It was as if the world had frozen, leaving only the flow of her sword intent.
However, Zhang Xian knew his master had only recovered to the third stage. Forcing a confrontation with a level-six enemy meant she was using a secret technique with a devastatingly high cost.

The battle resumed. Zhang Xian and Liu Qingxuan joined forces against Lu Qing. Unfortunately, though both Liu Qingxuan and Lu Qing were at the sixth tier, Liu Qingxuan had spent her life on Green Wood Peak. She had the cultivation, but she lacked combat experience.

Zhang Xian held spirit talismans and top-grade artifacts, but against a cultivator with one foot in the late Golden Core stage, the gap was too wide. Several self-destructed artifacts failed to inflict real damage on Lu Qing.

Even worse, Lu Qing and Jian Chen grew steadier as they fought, their spiritual energy appearing endless. Zhang Xian and Liu Qingxuan were in constant peril, barely holding on with their remaining defensive artifacts.
Meanwhile, in the sky above, the Buddha light of the swastika grew increasingly radiant. Unnoticed at first, faint traces of pink began to permeate the air.
Something's wrong! Zhang Xian’s heart sank.

Lu Qing unleashed a barrage of green thorns, forcing them back. Liu Qingxuan grunted softly, her body failing to react. Zhang Xian quickly embraced her and ignited a wind talisman, moving them several zhang away just in time to avoid the strike.
"Pfft!"
Liu Qingxuan suddenly spat out a mouthful of pink mist. Her legs went weak as she collapsed into Zhang Xian’s arms. "So hot..."
Her gaze was unfocused. One hand unconsciously tugged at her clothes while the other reached toward Zhang Xian.

Lu Qing gave a cold smile. His Green Wood Sword Qi transformed into venomous pythons. Holding Liu Qingxuan close, Zhang Xian retreated hastily. Several crisp ding sounds rang out—Li Fuxi had repelled the attack with one of her swords. She appeared beside them, her face flushed and her Taoist robe soaked with sweat.
Her twin swords remained steady, though her voice trembled. "Don't lose focus!" Several faint blue lights shimmered around her, enveloping the three of them.

"Too late! The Joy Formation is complete; where the Buddha's light shines becomes a sea of Desire." Jian Chen laughed heartily. "Fellow Daoist Fuxi, become this poor monk's cauldron. Ascend to bliss with me."
Only then did Zhang Xian realize the Swastika Grand Array not only blocked their exit but also acted as a potent aphrodisiac. Both women had been poisoned.
"Holy Monk, release my master," Zhang Xian suddenly interjected. "How about I become your cauldron instead?"
Everyone froze.
"You?" Jian Chen’s eyelids twitched wildly.
"I can be both giver or receiver," Zhang Xian said. "Or perhaps you could be my cauldron too."
These words shocked Jian Chen so much he involuntarily took a step back.
"Don't waste words with him!" Lu Qing shouted, noticing Zhang Xian’s hands making small movements.
Suddenly, a shuttle artifact appeared in Liu Qingxuan’s delirious hand. Her figure vanished instantly.
"A teleportation artifact?!" Jian Chen and Lu Qing were stunned. Such items were astronomically valuable.

Having sent Liu Qingxuan to safety, Zhang Xian’s aura plummeted; he had expended his vital essence to activate the device. He kept moving, however, layering several earth spirit shields around himself and Li Fuxi.
"Careful!" Jian Chen’s pupils contracted.
"Boom!"
A massive spiritual light erupted above their heads, engulfing everyone.
"Ah!"
Lu Qing’s scream was drowned by the roar. When the dust settled, half of Lu Qing’s body was charred black. Jian Chen wasn't much better; his robes were tattered and his aura severely weakened.
As Zhang Xian’s shields shattered, Li Fuxi’s magic swords—one gold, one blue—shot out toward Lu Qing.

The severely wounded Lu Qing roared, summoning his sword to block the golden blade, but the blue sword followed instantly, piercing his chest. With a flash of sword light, his scream ceased. Li Fuxi had severed his head.
Zhang Xian, his aura nearly gone, threw out two final thunder talismans. One was blocked by Jian Chen, but the other blasted Lu Qing’s remains into dust.
Body and spirit annihilated.
"Now only you remain," Zhang Xian said calmly, supporting an exhausted Li Fuxi.
Li Fuxi collapsed against Zhang Xian, her eyes dazed with intoxication. Yet, even in her state, her swords continued to circle them protectively. She was fighting to stay conscious.
Jian Chen took a deep breath. Using an unknown secret technique, his injuries began healing at a visible rate. He snarled, "Let's see what other tricks you have left!"
"Bald donkey, look up." Zhang Xian pointed skyward.

Jian Chen looked up to see an enormous flying ship directly above the swastika. The array had faded significantly after the second blast. Now, atop the ship, a massive cannon barrel was frantically focusing spirit stone energy.
"How dare you!"
Jian Chen formed a magic seal to slash at the ship, but it didn't leave a scratch. He decisively turned back to attack Zhang Xian and Li Fuxi.
Both were at their absolute limit. Li Fuxi adopted a purely defensive stance. When she was unable to hold on, Zhang Xian used spirit talismans to flash away, buying precious seconds of respite.
"Boom!"
The ship finished charging. A spiritual cannon fired, striking the eye of the swastika array. The golden barrier shook violently and then shattered. The backlash made Jian Chen spit out golden blood.

Jian Chen roared, leaping toward the flying ship like an arrow. He chanted an incantation, palms pressed together, as a hundred-zhang-tall blood Buddha phantom manifested behind him. The phantom chopped down with a giant palm.
"Hummm—"
The ship emitted an intense hum, generating a transparent barrier. The giant palm struggled against it but failed to break through.
Jing Chen glared furiously. His full-power strike couldn't even breach the shield?
Through the barrier, he finally saw a figure approaching the edge of the deck—another Zhang Xian.
"Impressive!" the man praised. "Bald friend, care to come aboard? We could study some cauldron techniques together."
Jian Chen spat another mouthful of golden blood.
This Zhang Xian's aura was weak—only early Foundation Establishment—and he looked pale, but his face was full of mockery.
This was the true body. He had been on board the entire time. No wonder the Joy Formation hadn't affected him; the one below was just a puppet.
"You have truly broadened this poor monk's horizons," Jian Chen laughed, his eyes turning crimson with rage.
Behind Zhang Xian, Captain Yunshang stared expressionlessly at the monk. She gestured slightly, and the bow cannon slowly swiveled to aim at him.
Jian Chen froze.
"Someday, I will slaughter your entire sect!" Without hesitation, he transformed into golden light and fled, leaving only a venomous curse behind.
"Save it," Zhang Xian coughed, turning away. "Leaving harsh words just makes you look like you have no style."

Meanwhile, the puppet-Zhang supported Li Fuxi as they flew toward the gangplank. She was now completely delirious. Her burning cheek rubbed against the puppet’s neck. Her usually cool voice was now soaked in a honeyed tone.
"You feel so cool..."
"Master, stop rubbing," Zhang Xian sighed. "This puppet has no temperature."

chapters.title: Chapter 69 Master, I Beg You
paragraphs: Once Li Fuxi was safely aboard the flying vessel, Zhang Xian finally let his guard down. The cost of the battle hit him instantly; blood seeped from his nose and mouth, and his head throbbed with a white-hot, excruciating pain. He had been running on pure willpower while facing Jian Chen.

Using the Void Breaking Shuttle to teleport Liu Qingxuan had exacted a heavy toll on his vital essence. His cultivation had plummeted back to the third level of Foundation Establishment, and his spiritual roots were severely damaged.
As his puppet clone collapsed onto the deck, Zhang Xian’s true body rushed forward to support Li Fuxi. The moment he touched her, he was startled by the frightening heat radiating from her skin.

"Get away from me," Li Fuxi murmured. Her voice was sweet and cloying, a stark contrast to her usual icy tone. She tried to push him away, but her limbs were leaden. Instead of resisting, her arms betrayed her, wrapping uncontrollably around his neck.
A dizzying, alluring fragrance filled his lungs. Zhang Xian turned his head sharply toward Yun Shang. "How do we resolve the effects of this Joy Formation?"

He had already ordered other puppet maids to tend to Liu Qingxuan. Through their vision, he could see her face was flushed a deep crimson, her breathing rapid and shallow. Her condition was just as dire.

"To the hot spring room, immediately!" Yun Shang commanded, trailing close behind him. "We must lower her temperature first. Master Fuxi must remain conscious. I will then use spiritual energy as a medium to transfer the Joy Passion Poison into my own body. As a puppet, I am immune to its effects."

As he carried her the short distance, Zhang Xian felt the soft, scalding weight in his arms. The scent of the poison emanating from her was so potent that the corners of his own eyes began to redden. He struggled to maintain his composure.
Thank goodness I used a puppet for the battle, he thought. If I had been down there in person, I would have lost my mind and been running around naked by now.
He lowered Li Fuxi into the pool, but she was already slipping into unconsciousness. He nudged her shoulder, but she only clung to him mindlessly, whispering into his ear, "Go away... go away..."
"She won't wake up! What now?"
Yun Shang sat behind Li Fuxi and calmly removed the woman's outer robe. Zhang Xian froze, momentarily speechless at the sight.
The puppet pressed her palms against Li Fuxi’s back, near her heart, and surged her spiritual energy. Threads of biting cold air immediately began to seep into the water.
"It is not enough; she must be awake," Yun Shang stated with the flat, analytical tone of a machine.
Looking at Li Fuxi’s delicate, pained face, Zhang Xian felt his resolve crumbling. A traitorous thought crossed his mind: Should I just handle this myself? I could claim it was for detoxification.

Damn it! What am I thinking? he cursed inwardly. The poison is getting to me too. Li Fuxi had reached a high level in the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra; losing her virginity now would ruin her cultivation. Beyond that, Zhang Xian had no doubt she would kill him the moment she recovered.

He took a deep breath, forcing his pulse to slow. He steeled his heart and delivered a sharp slap to her cheek. However, his instincts took over at the last millisecond, and he pulled ninety percent of the force. It ended up feeling more like a tender caress.
Her skin was hot and incredibly smooth, but she remained unresponsive.
"I can't do it," Zhang Xian muttered. "Should I just use a sword?"
"Move," Yun Shang said.
Without hesitation, the puppet formed her hand into a finger-sword and condensed a sharp spike of ice, driving it directly into Li Fuxi’s shoulder.
"Holy crap!" Zhang Xian’s eyelids twitched. The ruthlessness of an emotionless construct was truly terrifying.
The shock worked. "Mmm!" Li Fuxi cried out in pain, her eyes fluttering open. The cold from the ice spike considerately staunched the bleeding even as she woke.

She looked at Zhang Xian with dazed, unfocused eyes, then surged forward and kissed him. Zhang Xian was shoved back by the force of her embrace. Peach-flavored, was his only coherent thought before a sharp pain flared on his lip—she had bitten him hard enough to draw blood.
"Get out!"
A sliver of her reason had returned. She tried to push him away, but her arms only held him tighter.
"Get out! I beg you!" Her voice broke into a sob.
Zhang Xian forcibly broke her embrace. Her face was a mask of dazed desire, but clear tears were streaming down her face. He looked at Yun Shang, who gave a slight nod.
"It is ready," the puppet confirmed.
Zhang Xian placed two Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seeds and two Immortal Ascension Pills on the jade platform. Without a word, he turned and retreated from the room.

He hurried to a nearby cultivation chamber where Liu Qingxuan was being kept. Her condition had reached a breaking point; pink flames were beginning to scorch the floorboards around her, and the air was thick with a hazy, rose-colored dust.
"Is there a way to handle this?" Zhang Xian held his breath, calling out to the puppet maid standing guard.
"Yes," the maid replied. Since Yun Shang controlled all puppets on the ship, she was effectively speaking through this one as well.
"There's a way for this too?" Zhang Xian asked, amazed by the depth of the knowledge Sister Zhiyin had programmed into her creations.
"The poison she inhaled is lighter," the maid explained. "However, I cannot focus on two souls at once. I am currently occupied with Master Fuxi. You must set up a Taiyi Spirit-Clearing Array here."
"This array will cause the clear qi to rise and the turbid thoughts to sink. It will stall the poison’s corrosion until I have finished with Master Fuxi and can free my hands to resolve this."
"There won't be any side effects?" Zhang Xian asked, still feeling uneasy.
"Rest assured," the maid replied firmly.

Peach-flavored, was his only coherent thought before a sharp pain flared on his lip—she had bitten him hard enough to draw blood.
"Get out!"
A sliver of her reason had returned.
She tried to push him away, but her arms only held him tighter.
"Get out!
I beg you!" Her voice broke into a sob.
Zhang Xian forcibly broke her embrace.
Her face was a mask of dazed desire, but clear tears were streaming down her face.
He looked at Yun Shang, who gave a slight nod.
"It is ready," the puppet confirmed.
Zhang Xian placed two Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seeds and two Immortal Ascension Pills on the jade platform.
Without a word, he turned and retreated from the room.
He hurried to a nearby cultivation chamber where Liu Qingxuan was being kept.
Her condition had reached a breaking point; pink flames were beginning to scorch the floorboards around her, and the air was thick with a hazy, rose-colored dust.
"Is there a way to handle this?" Zhang Xian held his breath, calling out to the puppet maid standing guard.
"Yes," the maid replied.
Since Yun Shang controlled all puppets on the ship, she was effectively speaking through this one as well.
"There's a way for this too?" Zhang Xian asked, amazed by the depth of the knowledge Sister Zhiyin had programmed into her creations.
"The poison she inhaled is lighter," the maid explained.
"However, I cannot focus on two souls at once.
I am currently occupied with Master Fuxi.
You must set up a Taiyi Spirit-Clearing Array here."
"This array will cause the clear qi to rise and the turbid thoughts to sink.
It will stall the poison’s corrosion until I have finished with Master Fuxi and can free my hands to resolve this."
"There won't be any side effects?" Zhang Xian asked, still feeling uneasy.
"Rest assured," the maid replied firmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 70 I’m Done Pretending, I’m Coming Clean
paragraphs: Morning light pierced through the clouds as Zhang Xian pushed open the cabin door. Liu Qingxuan was still in a deep, heavy slumber.
Not far from the entrance, a maidservant stood silently, having remained unmoving throughout the entire night.
"How is Master doing?" Zhang Xian asked.
"The True One is well," the maidservant replied. Her eyes glowed with a soft white light, projecting Yun Shang's current field of vision directly into Zhang Xian's mind.
In the misty hot spring pool, Li Fuxi sat with her back to the observer, completely immersed in the water. Her wet hair clung to her slender, unclothed back.
"Ahem, no need to show me that."

"The True One regained full consciousness during the night," the maidservant's voice remained flat and emotionless. "The residual impurities of the Passion Poison will likely take about three days to be completely cleansed."

"That's good to hear." Zhang Xian finally let out a sigh of relief. "By the way, I noticed Supervisor Liu is still very weak. We neutralized the Joy Poison yesterday, so why is she still like this? Could there be lingering side effects?"

"Supervisor Liu remains unconscious due to a backlash from the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra," Yun Shang explained through the puppet. "When her cultivation reached minor completion and she lost her virginity, it was accompanied by intense pain. Furthermore, a portion of her cultivation realm has been transferred to the person who took her primordial yin."

Zhang Xian froze. No wonder he had felt so refreshed and clear-headed upon waking; the backlash from consuming his essence blood during the battle had been largely replenished. But the cost to Liu Qingxuan...

"As the name suggests, the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra requires three turns for entry-level, six for minor completion, and nine for major completion. These correspond to the Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, and Nascent Soul stages. Losing one's virginity before major completion damages the technique's efficacy and causes the practitioner's realm to fall. The higher the cultivation level, the greater the damage."
"Supervisor Liu stopped her cultivation after reaching the sixth turn. With enough rest, her realm will gradually recover."
Zhang Xian nodded slowly. No one had ever explained this to him. Now he understood why Li Fuxi had been so adamant about Lin Yinyin reaching the Golden Core stage as quickly as possible.

He thought of how Liu Qingxuan hadn't said a word about the risks during their intimacy. He realized only now how great her sacrifice had been. Zhang Xian immediately ordered the maidservant to watch over her and alert him the moment she showed signs of waking.

Afterward, he began taking stock of the vessel’s resources. To break the Joy Swastika Formation, the ship had fired its spirit energy cannon three times. Each shot consumed 600 high-grade spirit stones. Defending against Jian Chen's attacks had cost another 1,000.

The high-grade spirit stones gifted by Yun Wanqing were gone. Zhang Xian had to contribute an additional 2,000 from his own pocket just to keep things running. This ship truly burned through money. Compared to these expenditures, the daily maintenance cost of five high-grade stones seemed like a light drizzle.

With Liu Qingxuan unconscious and his master's situation delicate, Zhang Xian kept the vessel hovering in mid-air near the ruins of the Muling Sect, activating the concealment array. He spent the rest of the day replenishing backup spirit stones at various points on the ship.
Evening fell before Liu Qingxuan finally stirred. Her eyelashes fluttered, and her pale face looked small and fragile against the brocade quilt.
She opened her eyes to find Zhang Xian sitting by her bed. A bowl of freshly prepared soup rested on the small table beside him. Zhang Xian gently brushed her damp hair away from her temples.
"You're awake? Come, have something to drink."
"Mmm." With his support, Liu Qingxuan sat up. She sniffed the steam rising from the bowl. "Return-to-Origin Spirit Milk... This is a bit wasteful, isn't it?"
"What waste? Why didn't you tell me about the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra? If Captain Yun Shang hadn't told me, I would never have known."

"I never intended to cultivate it to major completion anyway," Liu Qingxuan whispered, her voice faint as she nuzzled her head against Zhang Xian's palm. "But you! Your spiritual foundation isn't even stable. How dare you consume your essence blood at the Foundation Establishment stage just to activate an artifact for me? Do you know that lost essence blood is almost impossible to compensate for?"

"Coming to the Muling Sect was my idea. How could I let you take the risks?" Zhang Xian smiled. "Besides, my family has vast wealth. A little essence blood is no big deal. I'll replenish it in no time."

"Always boasting," she murmured, a faint blush rising on her cheeks. "Last night, I kept wondering how you would help us detoxify... I never imagined you wouldn't take advantage of the situation until the very end. That was when I finally confirmed my feelings."
"Haha! Really? To be honest, when Yun Shang told me there was a way to detoxify you... I did feel a bit disappointed."
"So you finally admit it! You little pervert!" Liu Qingxuan lightly punched his arm.
"Me? I wonder who shattered the Taiyi Clear Spirit Formation with a single finger? Yun Shang set it up for nothing."
"Don't bring that up! That... that was because the residual poison hadn't cleared yet!" Utterly embarrassed, Liu Qingxuan tried to hide her face under the quilt.
Seeing her shy demeanor, Zhang Xian leaned down and kissed her deeply until she was breathless.
"You shameless rogue!" she squeaked, hiding under the covers again.
Zhang Xian laughed, but seeing her pale complexion, he decided not to tease her further. He placed a jade vial in her hand. "These are for you."

Liu Qingxuan looked inside—it contained a Marrow Cleansing Fruit and an Immortal Ascension Pill. She gasped, finally understanding how Lin Yinyin and Li Fuxi had improved their spiritual roots so rapidly.
She gripped the vial tightly. "I'm not with you for these things."
"I know," Zhang Xian said gently. "But now that you're my woman, I won't let you suffer. These things are nothing. Don't refuse me in the future."

Hearing the words "my woman," a wave of joy washed over her. "So you had designs on me all along... Wait! You had Marrow Cleansing Fruits this whole time? You pretended to give me a damaged one just so you could 'research' it with me! How utterly shameless!"
"Exactly! It was all to get closer to you. Now I’m done pretending; I’m coming clean! I suppose I should thank that bald monk for giving me a helping hand."
She chuckled softly but winced as the movement tugged at the dull pain in her dantian. Zhang Xian quickly channeled gentle spiritual energy into her until the pain eased.
"What do we do next?" she asked softly.
"I plan to report this to the sect and let them handle it. Do you know who that Jian Chen is?"

"I rarely leave Green Wood Peak, so I don't know him, but your master seemed familiar with him," Liu Qingxuan said. "I'll send word to my father. The sect has elders skilled in divination; they can help locate Jian Chen."
"Good idea. By the way..." Zhang Xian hesitated. "Regarding the Immortal Ascension Pill..."
"I understand. Sudden enlightenment, right?" A knowing smile danced in her eyes. "I won't even tell my father."

chapters.title: Chapter 71 The Master Is Reimbursed
paragraphs: Liu Qingxuan reported the incident to the sect, and the news ignited a wave of fury throughout the Yunmiao Sect. Word spread quickly that a group of powerful elders was already en route to provide reinforcements.
In the days that followed, Zhang Xian devoted himself to Liu Qingxuan’s recovery. Despite his focus, he made sure to visit Li Fuxi daily to monitor her condition.
Finally, on the third day, the Joyful Poison within Li Fuxi’s body was completely purged. She returned to her own cabin to recover in solitude.
Zhang Xian pushed the door open and stepped inside. He found Li Fuxi sitting cross-legged in a meditative stance. Though her face remained pale, her breathing had finally stabilized.
"Master," he said softly.
Li Fuxi opened her eyes. Over the past few days, she had extended her spiritual sense and knew Zhang Xian had been staying in Liu Qingxuan’s room. She already had a sense of what had transpired.
"What is the situation with Supervisor Liu?" she asked.
Zhang Xian gave a bitter smile. "The passion poison flared up. Captain Yunshang could only save one person, so I had to take care of the other."
"Oh? Then why did you choose to save me?" The question left her mouth before she could think. Realizing it sounded inappropriate, she quickly pivoted. "Is she alright?"
"She is fine. She just needs rest," Zhang Xian replied. "I’ve been looking after her, and the cultivation she lost should be replenished soon."
Hearing this, Li Fuxi felt an inexplicable pang of sourness in her heart.
She told herself it was guilt. She had come here to supervise Zhang Xian on Lin Yinyin’s behalf, yet she had nearly been compromised herself.
"This matter isn't your fault," she said. "But you should consider how you will explain this to Liu Huaigu. Jianchen schemed for so long, only for you to reap the benefits."
Zhang Xian offered an awkward smile and changed the subject. "By the way, what is the deal with that bald monk? You seemed to recognize him."

"I saw him years ago at a martial arts gathering in the Southern Region," Li Fuxi explained. "He is from the Mountain Chan Monastery. Back then, we were both at the fourth level of the Golden Core realm. I defeated him."
"That golden array with the swastika symbol... is he from the Joyful Chan Monastery?" Zhang Xian asked. "It didn't look like an orthodox technique. Does Mountain Chan Monastery not care?"
The six major powers of the Southern Region all claimed to be righteous. An array that forced aphrodisiacs on people felt far too sinister.
Li Fuxi shook her head. "That array isn't from the Joyful Chan Monastery. They believe in the harmony of yin and yang—a path for two people to comprehend the Great Dao together. This was different."
She frowned, her voice lowering. "Jianchen used to be quiet and reserved. Furthermore, he originally came from the Six Paths Chan Monastery."
Zhang Xian’s brow furrowed. If both his temperament and his techniques had changed, something was deeply wrong.

"It isn’t just Jianchen," Li Fuxi continued. "The sudden surge in power among the Muling Sect members is abnormal. They were recovering from injuries far too quickly during the fight. There is a hidden force at play here."
She looked at him curiously. "How did you figure out they were the problem so quickly?
"I guessed," Zhang Xian admitted. "It was suspicious that only one cultivator returned from that minor world. Lu Qing singled him out as a scapegoat to stop us from investigating further."
He shrugged. "As for the soul-searching technique, I was bluffing. If they had kept their composure, I would have been out of options."
Li Fuxi snorted lightly. "You are far too clever for your own good."
"You proved there is a conspiracy," she added, her tone turning serious. "But be careful. They will likely return. Your friend’s minor world is still in danger."

"I’ve already asked Yun Wanqing to guard the entrance," Zhang Xian reassured her. "She has people setting up defensive arrays now. Our enemies prefer to act in the shadows; they won't charge into a fortified position recklessly."
Li Fuxi’s expression darkened slightly. "You certainly have a close relationship with her."
"We're just friends," Zhang Xian sighed. "Anyway, Master, what about your cultivation?"

"It’s fine," she said dismissively. "I used a secret technique to force a breakthrough. Since I was already at the sixth level of the Golden Core before, the damage isn't fatal. I’ve dropped to the second level, but I’ll stabilize in time."
Zhang Xian wasn't convinced. He quietly summoned his system to check her status.
[Li Fuxi: 67-point Daughter of Destiny; Current Favorability: 45]
He realized her foundation was likely damaged again, even if she wouldn't admit it. But he also noticed something else: her Favorability had increased in secret.

Zhang Xian had already given her Immortal Ascension Pills and Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seeds. However, such treasures lost their efficacy after multiple uses. He needed a different approach.
Thud!
He slammed a massive chest onto the floor, shaking the room.
"Master, I don't know how else to compensate you," Zhang Xian said. "There are 50,000 high-grade spirit stones in here. Use them to buy whatever medicine you need."
Li Fuxi stared at the chest, stunned. "What did you say?"
"50,000 high-grade spirit stones," he repeated. "I know sword cultivators aren't usually wealthy. Take these and improve your living conditions."
Li Fuxi was speechless. She hadn't even seen 5,000 high-grade stones at once in her entire life. Selling her entire peak wouldn't fetch that much.
"It’s too much... I can't accept this," she managed to say, though her voice lacked conviction.
"Master, are you sure?" Zhang Xian teased. "I was going to give these to Chief Liu Huaigu as a betrothal gift. If you don't want them, I'll just give them all to her—a nice round 100,000."
Li Fuxi gritted her teeth, her small fists clenching.
"Fine... leave them," she snapped. "I’ll just hold onto them for you."
Zhang Xian cheered internally. The "jealousy" trick worked every time.
[Ding! Successfully gifted 50,000 high-grade spirit stones. 30,000 stones exceed Li Fuxi’s limit. Converted return: 2,000,000 high-grade spirit stones.]
Well now, Zhang Xian thought, Master has also been filled up.
He glanced at the mountain of wealth in his system space. He was running out of things to buy.
"Just what kind of power is behind you?" Li Fuxi asked, her cheeks flushing with a mix of shame and excitement. "No one in the Southern Region can produce this much liquid wealth."
She couldn't help it. With this gold, she could move from being a penniless ascetic to the wealthiest lady in the sect. She could finally maintain her swords with the finest materials.
"My family just owns a few mines," Zhang Xian said non-chalantly. "If you run out, just come to me. I'll make sure you're satisfied."
Li Fuxi looked at him nervously. She suspected he had used this same "wealth offensive" on Lin Yinyin and Liu Qingxuan.
Then, a memory flashed in her mind—of how she had clung to him while poisoned, begging for a kiss.
"Master? Why is your face so red?" Zhang Xian asked.
"It’s... it’s just the heat from the hot springs!" she stammered, avoiding his eyes. "And about what happened when I was poisoned... don't you dare tell anyone."
Zhang Xian looked blankly at her. "Master? What are you talking about? When were you poisoned?"
Li Fuxi exhaled in relief. "Good. Now leave. I need to rest."
"Your disciple takes his leave."
After he left, Li Fuxi let out a long sigh. She tried to meditate, staring at the calligraphy of the word "Calm" on her wall, but her heart wouldn't settle.
"This place is too luxurious," she whispered to herself. "It’s bad for the soul."
And yet, her heart felt strangely empty the moment he walked out.
[Ding! Current Favorability: 48]

If you don't want them, I'll just give them all to her—a nice round 100,000."
Li Fuxi gritted her teeth, her small fists clenching.
"Fine... leave them," she snapped.
"I’ll just hold onto them for you."
Zhang Xian cheered internally.
The "jealousy" trick worked every time.
[Ding!
Successfully gifted 50,000 high-grade spirit stones.
30,000 stones exceed Li Fuxi’s limit.
Converted return: 2,000,000 high-grade spirit stones.]
Well now, Zhang Xian thought, Master has also been filled up.
He glanced at the mountain of wealth in his system space.
He was running out of things to buy.
"Just what kind of power is behind you?" Li Fuxi asked, her cheeks flushing with a mix of shame and excitement.
"No one in the Southern Region can produce this much liquid wealth."
She couldn't help it.

She could finally maintain her swords with the finest materials.
"My family just owns a few mines," Zhang Xian said non-chalantly.
"If you run out, just come to me.
I'll make sure you're satisfied."
Li Fuxi looked at him nervously.
She suspected he had used this same "wealth offensive" on Lin Yinyin and Liu Qingxuan.
Then, a memory flashed in her mind—of how she had clung to him while poisoned, begging for a kiss.
"Master?
Why is your face so red?" Zhang Xian asked.
"It’s... it’s just the heat from the hot springs!" she stammered, avoiding his eyes.
"And about what happened when I was poisoned... don't you dare tell anyone."
Zhang Xian looked blankly at her.
"Master?
What are you talking about?
When were you poisoned?"
Li Fuxi exhaled in relief.
"Good.
Now leave.
I need to rest."
"Your disciple takes his leave."
After he left, Li Fuxi let out a long sigh.
She tried to meditate, staring at the calligraphy of the word "Calm" on her wall, but her heart wouldn't settle.
"This place is too luxurious," she whispered to herself.
"It’s bad for the soul."
And yet, her heart felt strangely empty the moment he walked out.
[Ding!

chapters.title: Chapter 72 He Seems to Like You More
paragraphs: Early the next morning, a low rumble echoed across the horizon as two massive flying ships tore through the clouds.
The vessels were enormous, their hulls intricately carved with blue cloud patterns and the character "Miao" engraved boldly upon their prows.

Leader Wangya stood at the bow of the lead ship with his hands behind his back, flanked by a group of elders. Among them were Zhiyin, the supervisor of Heavenly Puppet Peak, and Liu Huaigu, the leader of Green Wood Peak.

The group stepped onto the deck of Zhang Xian’s smaller vessel and scanned their surroundings. Though his ship was compact, the elders were secretly impressed. The complexity of the spirit-gathering arrays was far more exquisite than those found even on the Yunmiao Sect’s flagships.
However, when their eyes fell upon Li Fuxi and Liu Qingxuan, their expressions shifted instantly.
Li Fuxi stood at the second level of the Golden Core realm, her aura unstable and her complexion deathly pale.

Liu Qingxuan, now at the fourth level of Golden Core, had suffered an even more drastic drop in cultivation. Yet, despite her weakened state, there was an unmistakable air of maturity between her brows.
In contrast, Zhang Xian remained at the sixth level of Foundation Establishment, his spiritual energy robust and pulsing as if he were on the cusp of a breakthrough.
Wangya’s eye twitched, while Liu Huaigu’s frown deepened. To an experienced eye, this looked like the telltale backlash of a broken Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.
But such delicate matters were not to be discussed in the open. Wangya cleared his throat. "Recount what happened once more."

Zhang Xian cupped his hands and detailed the battle at Muling Sect. He glossed over certain ambiguous details, merely stating that he had forced Jianchen to retreat using spirit talismans and ship cannons, and that the two women had suffered cultivation damage due to a potent love poison.
The reactions were mixed. Some elders marveled at Zhang Xian’s puppet mastery, while others were taken aback by his ruthlessness in erasing an entire sect with a single cannon blast.
Zhiyin, however, had a playful glint in her eyes. She circled Zhang Xian slowly. "Is this the puppet that fooled Lu Qing and Jianchen?"
Zhang Xian smiled. "It is. I’ve spent the last few days in the inner cabin, seeking guidance from the captain on my cultivation."
He had realized that Captain Yunshang was not only a master pilot but possessed a vast reservoir of knowledge, which made him respect Supervisor Zhiyin even more.

Wangya and Liu Huaigu were genuinely surprised. Until Zhiyin pointed it out, they hadn't realized they were speaking to a puppet. It was so lifelike that without a deep scan, it was impossible to distinguish from a human.
Using puppets as proxies was a long-standing tradition in the Yunmiao Sect, so no one took offense. After all, Zhiyin herself often roamed the sect in puppet form.
Without any hesitation, Zhiyin pinched the puppet’s cheek. "So realistic! Did you build this yourself?
"An elder from my family assisted me," Zhang Xian fabricated quickly.
"I’d love to consult with them in person," Zhiyin purred, leaning closer. She began touching and squeezing the puppet’s frame, marveling at the craftsmanship.

Zhiyin was a charming woman, and her proximity was... distracting. Her hands were roaming over Zhang Xian’s puppet body quite freely, making the other elders uncomfortable. However, since it was technically one puppet "interacting" with another, they looked away and treated it as professional curiosity.
"There will be an opportunity," Zhang Xian said with an awkward smile. "We owe much to your puppet techniques, Sister Zhiyin. Without them, we wouldn't have survived."
"Hehe. A puppet is only as good as its master."
"By the way," Zhang Xian continued, "can you help me upgrade this ship? I want everything pushed to the absolute limit—offense, defense, everything."
"You want to overhaul it after just one trip? This ship cost several million mid-grade spirit stones. It’s nearly as expensive as a flagship."
"We nearly died. Cost is no object."
Zhiyin’s eyes sharpened. "Do you understand what 'cost is no object' truly implies?"
"Literally. If this ship is worth 80,000 high-grade spirit stones, I’m willing to pay ten times that. Or twenty."
"Are you serious?"
"I never joke about my life. We can settle on a deposit right now."
Zhiyin gasped. A transaction of this magnitude was unheard of in the Southern Region. The commission alone would be astronomical.
"I’ll look into it," she said breathlessly. "Su Ling and I can personally handle the final puppet cluster. But for a deal this large... why aren't you asking Sect Master Yun?"
At the mention of the Sect Master, Wangya—who had been speaking with Li Fuxi—pricked up his ears.
"We’re too familiar," Zhang Xian laughed awkwardly. "I’m afraid she’d just give it to me for free, and I’d feel too embarrassed to accept."
"You two..." Zhiyin giggled, hiding her mouth behind her hand. "Sometimes I wonder if there are secrets between you."

Wangya felt a surge of irritation. He took a deep breath, trying to ignore the conversation, and turned back to Li Fuxi. "I will personally visit Shan Chanyuan to demand an explanation for Jianchen's ambush."
A white-robed elder nearby snorted. "Don't worry, Fuxi. Even if that bald thief flees the Southern Region, I will drag him back.

This was Elder Xingyin, the leader of the main peak. He was a legendary figure who had reached the peak of the Golden Core realm before Wangya even joined the sect. He was a master of divination and arrays; with him on the trail, Jianchen would have nowhere to hide.
"Thank you, Leader Xingyin," Li Fuxi said, bowing respectfully to her senior.

"The techniques used by Jianchen and the Muling Sect are perverted," Wangya noted. "And they threaten the safety of minor worlds. I’ve contacted the Great Xia Imperial Dynasty; I suspect a demonic resurgence."
Li Fuxi nodded. The rapid regeneration Jianchen and Lu Qing displayed suggested they were draining life force—a hallmark of demonic arts.
"Fuxi, you all should return to the sect to recuperate," Wangya ordered. "Elder Xingyin will investigate the surrounding area for clues while I head to the Imperial Dynasty."
"But the Muling Sect has been leveled," Li Fuxi reminded him.
Elder Xingyin chuckled. "Their base is gone, but their disciples are scattered. I’ll hunt them down one by one until someone talks."
As the elders prepared to depart, Liu Huaigu remained behind. "Go ahead, everyone. I’ll catch up."
Once the ships had sailed away, Liu Huaigu looked at his pale daughter and sighed. "Qingxuan, come into the cabin with me."
Knowing her father wanted a private word, Liu Qingxuan gave Zhang Xian a reassuring glance and followed him inside, closing the door behind them.
"Speak truthfully," Liu Huaigu said, his voice low and grave. "Exactly what happened?"
Liu Qingxuan looked at her father’s sharp gaze and quickly lowered her head. "Father, I..."
"Is your Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra broken?"
"Yes..." she whispered.
"And Li Fuxi? Did she also...?"
"No. Supervisor Fuxi used a secret method to force a breakthrough. She is suffering from the backlash."
Liu Huaigu let out a long sigh of relief. "Oh. Good. Then it seems that lad Zhang Xian likes you more after all."
"Huh?" Liu Qingxuan froze. She had braced herself for a lecture, not this.

chapters.title: Chapter 73 What Do You Have to Take Responsibility
paragraphs: Liu Qingxuan felt a mixture of embarrassment and annoyance upon hearing her father's blunt assessment. "Father, you didn't come all this way just to tell me that, did you?"

Liu Huaigu shook his head in silence. He had originally intended to nudge Zhang Xian and his daughter closer together, hoping their relationship would progress naturally, but he never expected them to move at such a breakneck pace. He truly didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
Suddenly, as if sensing an anomaly, he reached out. "Qingxuan, you—"
Before he could finish, he lightly pressed his fingertip against her wrist, channeling a trace of spiritual power into her pulse. A flicker of genuine surprise flashed in his eyes.
"Your spirit root," he said, his voice dropping to a low whisper. "It seems far more refined than before."

Liu Qingxuan had been consistently consuming the Immortal Ascension Pill and Marrow Cleansing Fruit provided by Zhang Xian, pushing her aptitude toward the legendary grade of a Heavenly Spirit Root. However, she had promised Zhang Xian to keep his gifts a secret.
"I... I had an epiphany during the battle," she whispered, unable to offer a better explanation.
"An epiphany?" Liu Huaigu’s mouth twitched as his meaningful gaze swept over his daughter’s reddened earlobes. "An epiphany in the middle of a life-or-death struggle?"
"Mhm..." Liu Qingxuan buried her face even lower.
Liu Huaigu stared at her for a long moment. He knew his daughter had been timid since childhood and was a terrible liar; whenever she tried to deceive him, she became nervous and began to stutter.
Ah, now that she has a sweetheart, she’s already started fooling her old man.
Liu Huaigu let out a long, weary sigh. "Forget it. I won't meddle in the affairs of you young people anymore."
He turned to leave but stopped abruptly in his tracks. "No, I can't let him off that easily. If I do, he won't learn to cherish you."
"Father!" Liu Qingxuan’s embarrassment reached a fever pitch, her ears turning a shade of red so deep they looked ready to bleed.
Ignoring her protest, Liu Huaigu flicked his sleeve. "Zhang Xian! Get in here!"

When Zhang Xian pushed the door open, he was met with a heavy atmosphere. Liu Huaigu sat stiffly behind the desk, his face a mask of stern authority as his fingers tapped a rhythmic beat on the wood. Liu Qingxuan stood to the side with her head bowed, stealing a quick, nervous glance at Zhang Xian before looking away.
"Chief Liu," Zhang Xian said, bowing respectfully.
"Hmph!" Liu Huaigu snorted.

"This matter is entirely my fault," Zhang Xian began earnestly. "The situation was urgent, and I was forced to resort to a final, desperate measure that offended Supervisor Liu. Please rest assured, Chief—as long as she does not disdain me, I will take full responsibility for her."
"Responsibility?" Liu Huaigu narrowed his eyes. "And just what do you have to offer in the name of responsibility?"
Without a word, Zhang Xian flicked his wrist. With a heavy clatter, a massive chest appeared on the floor. He opened the lid with a solemn expression.
"I possess little of value myself, but my clan is blessed with mineral resources. Here are fifty thousand top-grade spirit stones, offered as a betrothal gift for Supervisor Liu."
"Fifty thousand!?" Liu Qingxuan gasped, covering her mouth with her hand.

Liu Huaigu nearly tumbled off his stool. The brilliant spiritual light radiating from the chest was almost blinding. His Adam's apple bobbed as he stared at the mountain of wealth, struggling for several seconds to find his voice.
"You... you brat..." He couldn't manage a coherent sentence.

Liu Huaigu took several deep breaths, forcibly suppressing his shock to maintain a facade of composure. "Ahem... spirit stones alone are not enough. You must hold a Dao Companion Bonding Ceremony and announce it to the entire sect."
"That goes without saying," Zhang Xian agreed readily.
Liu Huaigu pondered for a moment. "Wait until you reach the Golden Core stage. Your current cultivation is too low, and your reputation in the sect is... complicated. There will be gossip."
"I accept those terms."

Satisfied, Liu Huaigu glanced at his daughter. Seeing the light in her eyes eased his mind. "Remember to maintain a professional distance once we return to the sect. It wouldn't be good for either of you if the disciples start whispering."
"This disciple understands," Zhang Xian said.
Liu Huaigu stood up and patted Zhang Xian on the shoulder. "Do not let her down."
With that, he strode out of the cabin, his departing figure looking significantly more cheerful. Fifty thousand top-grade spirit stones meant his daughter would never want for anything again.
[Ding! Transaction successful. 20,000 stones exceed Liu Qingxuan's limit; converted return: 3,000,000 top-grade spirit stones.]
It seems researchers really do need more funding, Zhang Xian thought.

Over the next few days, the ship continued its journey back to the Yunmiao Sect. Having benefited from his union with Liu Qingxuan, Zhang Xian’s progress was staggering. He not only recovered his lost cultivation but advanced to the seventh level of Foundation Establishment.
Up on the deck, Zhang Xian was practicing the art of sword flight.
"Keep your wrist steady. Channel your spiritual power evenly," Liu Qingxuan instructed.
She stood close behind him, her delicate hands supporting his wrist to guide the flow of energy. Her hair occasionally brushed against his neck, carrying a faint, sweet fragrance.
"Supervisor Liu is an excellent teacher," Zhang Xian remarked, turning his head to smile at her.
"Focus!" she chided, her ears heating up.
She tried to maintain a stern face, but seeing his mischievous grin, she couldn't help but pinch his arm in irritation. "If you keep laughing, I’ll stop the lesson!"
"Alright, alright—I’m being serious now." He reigned in his laughter, though he still stole glances at her flushed profile.

Suddenly, a cabin door creaked open. Li Fuxi stood in the doorway, taking in the scene. She saw Zhang Xian balanced on his flying sword with Liu Qingxuan practically plastered against his back, the two of them laughing intimately.
An inexplicable tightness gripped her chest. Her fingers clenched the fabric of her sleeve.
"Master!" Zhang Xian called out cheerfully.
Li Fuxi swept a cold, disdainful gaze over the pair. "You can't even master basic sword flight? How disgraceful."
She turned and marched away, her footsteps notably heavier than usual.
"Is Supervisor Fuxi angry?" Liu Qingxuan asked anxiously.
"Maybe she thinks I'm learning too slowly?" Zhang Xian pondered.
"But your progress is quite fast, especially with your improved spirit root," Liu Qingxuan added hesitantly. "Should you go ask her for advice?"
Zhang Xian shook his head. "She’s already gone. Besides, Supervisor Liu is doing just fine."
Master is quite cute when she’s grumpy, he thought privately.
Li Fuxi stomped through the corridors, nearly bumping into Captain Yunshang. She glared at the captain’s revealing attire.
Zhang Xian really is a little pervert, isn't he?
Hmph! Whatever. Why am I getting angry at a puppet anyway?

She retreated to her bedroom to meditate, but her mind was a whirlwind. Failing to find peace, she went to the hot spring instead. She submerged herself in the warm water until only her eyes peeked above the surface, staring blankly into the mist.
What is wrong with me?
I am his master. I should be the one teaching him sword flight. He should be coming to me for guidance!
Three days later, as the ship neared the Yunmiao Sect, Zhang Xian visited Liu Qingxuan’s cultivation chamber. She was sitting cross-legged, her complexion glowing with health and vitality.
"Fully recovered?" he asked with a smile.
She opened her eyes, beaming. "My spirit root has improved even further!"
She pointed a finger at a seed on the table. It sprouted instantly, transforming into a lush green vine in the blink of an eye.
Zhang Xian checked her status.
[Liu Qingxuan: 64-point Daughter of Destiny; Current Favorability: 70]
